import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { TelemetryPoint, TelemetrySession } from '../types/telemetry';
import { TelemetryContext } from './TelemetryContextDefinition';
import type { TelemetryContextValue } from './TelemetryContextDefinition';

interface TelemetryProviderProps {
  session: TelemetrySession;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Linearly interpolate between two points based on distance
 */
function interpolatePoint(p1: TelemetryPoint, p2: TelemetryPoint, d: number): TelemetryPoint {
  const span = p2.distance - p1.distance;
  if (span <= 0) return { ...p1 };
  const factor = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (d - p1.distance) / span));

  return {
    distance: d,
    time: p1.time + (p2.time - p1.time) * factor,
    speed: p1.speed + (p2.speed - p1.speed) * factor,
    throttle: p1.throttle + (p2.throttle - p1.throttle) * factor,
    brake: p1.brake + (p2.brake - p1.brake) * factor,
    gear: factor < 0.5 ? p1.gear : p2.gear,
    rpm: Math.round(p1.rpm + (p2.rpm - p1.rpm) * factor),
    steeringAngle: p1.steeringAngle + (p2.steeringAngle - p1.steeringAngle) * factor,
    gLat: p1.gLat + (p2.gLat - p1.gLat) * factor,
    gLong: p1.gLong + (p2.gLong - p1.gLong) * factor,
  };
}

/**
 * Find or interpolate TelemetryPoint at a specific track distance `d`
 */
function getPointAtDistance(lap: TelemetryPoint[], d: number): TelemetryPoint | null {
  if (lap.length === 0) return null;
  if (d <= lap[0]!.distance) return lap[0]!;
  if (d >= lap[lap.length - 1]!.distance) return lap[lap.length - 1]!;

  let low = 0;
  let high = lap.length - 1;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
    const pt = lap[mid]!;
    if (pt.distance === d) return pt;
    if (pt.distance < d) {
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  const i1 = Math.max(0, high);
  const i2 = Math.min(lap.length - 1, low);
  const p1 = lap[i1]!;
  const p2 = lap[i2]!;

  return interpolatePoint(p1, p2, d);
}

const TOTAL_TRACK_DISTANCE = 5793;

export const TelemetryProvider: React.FC<TelemetryProviderProps> = ({ session: initialSession, children }) => {
  const [activeSession, setActiveSession] = useState<TelemetrySession>(initialSession);
  const [activeDistance, setActiveDistanceState] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isHovering, setIsHoveringState] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlayingState] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [playbackSpeed, setPlaybackSpeedState] = useState<number>(1.0);

  // Refs for requestAnimationFrame playback loop
  const activeDistanceRef = useRef(activeDistance);
  const isPlayingRef = useRef(isPlaying);
  const playbackSpeedRef = useRef(playbackSpeed);
  const lastFrameTimeRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    activeDistanceRef.current = activeDistance;
  }, [activeDistance]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isPlayingRef.current = isPlaying;
  }, [isPlaying]);

  useEffect(() => {
    playbackSpeedRef.current = playbackSpeed;
  }, [playbackSpeed]);

  const setActiveDistance = useCallback((dist: number) => {
    const maxDist = activeSession.referenceLap[activeSession.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? TOTAL_TRACK_DISTANCE;
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxDist, dist));
    activeDistanceRef.current = clamped;
    setActiveDistanceState(clamped);
  }, [activeSession.referenceLap]);

  const switchSession = useCallback((newSession: TelemetrySession) => {
    setActiveSession(newSession);
    // Keep activeDistance clamped to new session's track length while preserving current progress
    const newMax = newSession.referenceLap[newSession.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? TOTAL_TRACK_DISTANCE;
    if (activeDistanceRef.current > newMax) {
      activeDistanceRef.current = newMax;
      setActiveDistanceState(newMax);
    }
  }, []);

  const setIsHovering = useCallback((hovering: boolean) => {
    setIsHoveringState(hovering);
  }, []);

  const setIsPlaying = useCallback((playing: boolean) => {
    setIsPlayingState(playing);
    if (playing) {
      lastFrameTimeRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  const togglePlay = useCallback(() => {
    setIsPlayingState((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (next) {
        lastFrameTimeRef.current = null;
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const setPlaybackSpeed = useCallback((speed: number) => {
    setPlaybackSpeedState(speed);
  }, []);

  const stepDistance = useCallback((deltaMeters: number) => {
    const maxDist = activeSession.referenceLap[activeSession.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? TOTAL_TRACK_DISTANCE;
    setActiveDistanceState((curr) => {
      let next = curr + deltaMeters;
      if (next < 0) next = 0;
      if (next > maxDist) next = maxDist;
      activeDistanceRef.current = next;
      return next;
    });
  }, [activeSession.referenceLap]);

  // 60fps requestAnimationFrame physics animation loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let animId: number;

    const animate = (timestamp: number) => {
      if (isPlayingRef.current) {
        if (lastFrameTimeRef.current !== null) {
          const deltaSec = (timestamp - lastFrameTimeRef.current) / 1000;
          const currentPt = getPointAtDistance(activeSession.referenceLap, activeDistanceRef.current);
          const currentSpeedKmh = currentPt?.speed ?? 200;
          const currentSpeedMs = (currentSpeedKmh * 1000) / 3600;

          const distanceDelta = currentSpeedMs * deltaSec * playbackSpeedRef.current;
          let nextDist = activeDistanceRef.current + distanceDelta;

          const maxDist = activeSession.referenceLap[activeSession.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? TOTAL_TRACK_DISTANCE;
          if (nextDist >= maxDist) {
            nextDist = nextDist % maxDist;
          }

          activeDistanceRef.current = nextDist;
          setActiveDistanceState(nextDist);
        }
        lastFrameTimeRef.current = timestamp;
      }

      animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    };
  }, [activeSession.referenceLap]);

  // Global keyboard shortcuts (Space to toggle play, Arrow Left/Right to seek 50m)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        document.activeElement?.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
        document.activeElement?.tagName === 'TEXTAREA'
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (e.code === 'Space') {
        e.preventDefault();
        togglePlay();
      } else if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault();
        stepDistance(-50);
      } else if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault();
        stepDistance(50);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [togglePlay, stepDistance]);

  const hoveredPointRef = useMemo(() => {
    return getPointAtDistance(activeSession.referenceLap, activeDistance);
  }, [activeSession.referenceLap, activeDistance]);

  const hoveredPointComp = useMemo(() => {
    return getPointAtDistance(activeSession.comparisonLap, activeDistance);
  }, [activeSession.comparisonLap, activeDistance]);

  const deltaAtHover = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hoveredPointRef || !hoveredPointComp) return null;
    return hoveredPointComp.time - hoveredPointRef.time;
  }, [hoveredPointRef, hoveredPointComp]);

  const value = useMemo<TelemetryContextValue>(() => ({
    session: activeSession,
    activeDistance,
    hoveredPointRef,
    hoveredPointComp,
    deltaAtHover,
    isHovering,
    isPlaying,
    playbackSpeed,
    activeSessionId: activeSession.id || 'benchmark-demo',
    setActiveDistance,
    setIsHovering,
    togglePlay,
    setIsPlaying,
    setPlaybackSpeed,
    stepDistance,
    switchSession,
  }), [
    activeSession,
    activeDistance,
    hoveredPointRef,
    hoveredPointComp,
    deltaAtHover,
    isHovering,
    isPlaying,
    playbackSpeed,
    setActiveDistance,
    setIsHovering,
    togglePlay,
    setIsPlaying,
    setPlaybackSpeed,
    stepDistance,
    switchSession,
  ]);

  return <TelemetryContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</TelemetryContext.Provider>;
};

=== FILE: src/context/useTelemetry.ts ===

import { useContext } from 'react';
import { TelemetryContext } from './TelemetryContextDefinition';
import type { TelemetryContextValue } from './TelemetryContextDefinition';

export function useTelemetry(): TelemetryContextValue {
  const context = useContext(TelemetryContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTelemetry must be used within a TelemetryProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

=== FILE: src/context/TelemetryContextDefinition.ts ===

import { createContext } from 'react';
import type { TelemetryPoint, TelemetrySession } from '../types/telemetry';

export interface TelemetryContextValue {
  session: TelemetrySession;
  activeDistance: number;
  hoveredPointRef: TelemetryPoint | null;
  hoveredPointComp: TelemetryPoint | null;
  deltaAtHover: number | null;
  isHovering: boolean;
  isPlaying: boolean;
  playbackSpeed: number; // 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0
  activeSessionId: string;
  setActiveDistance: (distance: number) => void;
  setIsHovering: (hovering: boolean) => void;
  togglePlay: () => void;
  setIsPlaying: (playing: boolean) => void;
  setPlaybackSpeed: (speed: number) => void;
  stepDistance: (deltaMeters: number) => void;
  switchSession: (newSession: TelemetrySession) => void;
}

export const TelemetryContext = createContext<TelemetryContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

import type {
  TelemetryPoint,
  TelemetrySession,
  SectorSplit,
  OpenF1Meeting,
  OpenF1Session,
  OpenF1Driver,
  OpenF1Lap,
  DriverMeta,
} from '../types/telemetry';
import realMonzaDataset from '../mock/realMonzaData.json';

const BASE_URL = 'https://api.openf1.org/v1';

export class HttpError extends Error {
  status: number;
  constructor(status: number, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.status = status;
    this.name = 'HttpError';
  }
}

/**
 * Custom OpenF1 query builder matching OpenF1's exact specification:
 * - Literal operators for dates: use `date>` and `date<` (do NOT use `>=` or `<=`).
 * - Do NOT encode colons ':' in timestamps or '>' and '<' symbols.
 * - If param key is 'date_start' or starts with 'date>': emit `date>${val}`
 * - If param key is 'date_end' or starts with 'date<': emit `date<${val}`
 * - For standard keys (session_key, driver_number, meeting_key, year): emit `${key}=${val}`
 * - Join them with '&'.
 * Example:
 * https://api.openf1.org/v1/car_data?session_key=9979&driver_number=4&date>2025-05-25T18:42:15.000&date<2025-05-25T18:43:59.000
 */
export function buildOpenF1Query(params: Record<string, string | number>): string {
  return Object.entries(params)
    .map(([key, val]) => {
      const valStr = String(val);
      if (key === 'date_start' || key.startsWith('date>')) {
        return `date>${valStr}`;
      }
      if (key === 'date_end' || key.startsWith('date<')) {
        return `date<${valStr}`;
      }
      return `${key}=${valStr}`;
    })
    .join('&');
}

/**
 * Formats a Date object cleanly into an OpenF1-compatible ISO string with exactly
 * 3 decimal places for milliseconds and the trailing 'Z' stripped.
 * e.g., '2025-05-25T18:42:15.000'
 */
export function formatOpenF1Timestamp(d: Date | number | string): string {
  const dateObj = typeof d === 'string' ? new Date(d) : typeof d === 'number' ? new Date(d) : d;
  return dateObj.toISOString().replace('Z', '');
}

// =========================================================================
// Client-side IndexedDB & LocalStorage Multi-Tiered Cache
// =========================================================================
const DB_NAME = 'ApexTrace_Telemetry_DB';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const STORE_NAME = 'openf1_cache';

let dbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

function getIDB(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB) {
    return Promise.resolve(null);
  }
  if (!dbPromise) {
    dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        const req = window.indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
        req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
          const db = req.result;
          if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
            db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
          }
        };
        req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
        req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        req.onblocked = () => resolve(null);
      } catch {
        resolve(null);
      }
    });
  }
  return dbPromise;
}

export async function getCache<T>(key: string): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    if (db) {
      return await new Promise<T | null>((resolve) => {
        try {
          const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
          const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
          const req = store.get(key);
          req.onsuccess = () => resolve((req.result as T) ?? null);
          req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        } catch {
          resolve(null);
        }
      });
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to web storage
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (item) return JSON.parse(item) as T;
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.sessionStorage) {
    try {
      const item = window.sessionStorage.getItem(key);
      if (item) return JSON.parse(item) as T;
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  return null;
}

export async function setCache<T>(key: string, value: T): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const db = await getIDB();
    if (db) {
      return await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        try {
          const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
          const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
          store.put(value, key);
          tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
          tx.onerror = () => resolve();
        } catch {
          resolve();
        }
      });
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall back to web storage
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
      return;
    } catch {
      // Quota exceeded
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.sessionStorage) {
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch {
      // Quota exceeded
    }
  }
}

// =========================================================================
// Request Queue with 300ms Cooldown & HTTP 429 Exponential Backoff
// =========================================================================
let lastRequestEndTime = 0;
const REQUEST_COOLDOWN_MS = 300;
let queuePromise: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function executeThrottledRequest<T>(fetchFn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const task = async () => {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - lastRequestEndTime;
    if (elapsed < REQUEST_COOLDOWN_MS) {
      await sleep(REQUEST_COOLDOWN_MS - elapsed);
    }
    try {
      return await fetchFn();
    } finally {
      lastRequestEndTime = Date.now();
    }
  };

  const next = queuePromise.then(task, task);
  queuePromise = next.catch(() => {});
  return next as Promise<T>;
}

async function fetchWithRetryAndThrottle<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  params: Record<string, string | number>,
  timeoutMs = 9000,
  onProgress?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<T[]> {
  const query = buildOpenF1Query(params);
  const cacheKey = `openf1_raw_${endpoint}_${query}`;

  const cached = await getCache<T[]>(cacheKey);
  if (cached && cached.length > 0) {
    return cached;
  }

  const url = `${BASE_URL}/${endpoint}?${query}`;
  const maxRetries = 2;
  const backoffDelays = [1500, 3000];

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      const result = await executeThrottledRequest(async () => {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
        try {
          const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
          if (res.status === 429) {
            throw new HttpError(429, 'OpenF1 Rate Limited (HTTP 429)');
          }
          if (res.status === 404) {
            // OpenF1 returns 404 when 0 rows match criteria; treat as empty result
            return [] as T[];
          }
          if (!res.ok) {
            throw new HttpError(res.status, `HTTP error ${res.status}`);
          }
          const json = await res.json();
          return Array.isArray(json) ? (json as T[]) : [];
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        }
      });

      if (result && result.length > 0) {
        await setCache(cacheKey, result);
      }
      return result;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const is429 = err instanceof HttpError && err.status === 429;
      if (is429 && attempt < maxRetries) {
        const waitMs = backoffDelays[attempt] ?? 1500;
        onProgress?.(
          `OpenF1 rate limit reached (HTTP 429). Throttling and retrying in ${(waitMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s (retry ${attempt + 1}/${maxRetries})...`
        );
        await sleep(waitMs);
        continue;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  return [];
}

/**
 * 4. Get the fastest lap for a driver in a session with graceful 404/empty handling
 */
export async function getFastestLap(
  sessionKey: number,
  driverNumber: number,
  driverCode?: string,
  onProgress?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<{ lap: OpenF1Lap | null; error?: string }> {
  const driverLabel = driverCode ? driverCode : `#${driverNumber}`;
  try {
    const laps = await fetchWithRetryAndThrottle<OpenF1Lap>(
      'laps',
      {
        session_key: sessionKey,
        driver_number: driverNumber,
      },
      9000,
      onProgress
    );

    if (!laps || laps.length === 0) {
      return {
        lap: null,
        error: `No completed laps recorded for Driver ${driverLabel} in this session.`,
      };
    }

    const validLaps = laps.filter(
      (l) => l.lap_duration && l.lap_duration > 50 && l.lap_duration < 140 && !l.is_pit_out_lap
    );

    if (validLaps.length === 0) {
      return {
        lap: null,
        error: `No completed laps recorded for Driver ${driverLabel} in this session.`,
      };
    }

    validLaps.sort((a, b) => (a.lap_duration ?? 999) - (b.lap_duration ?? 999));
    return { lap: validLaps[0]! };
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof HttpError && err.status === 404) {
      return {
        lap: null,
        error: `No completed laps recorded for Driver ${driverLabel} in this session.`,
      };
    }
    return { lap: null, error: (err as Error).message };
  }
}

interface RawCarData {
  date: string;
  speed: number;
  rpm: number;
  throttle: number;
  brake: number;
  n_gear: number;
  drs?: number;
}

interface RawLocationData {
  date: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}

/**
 * 5. Fetch and normalize driver telemetry for an exact lap window
 * Buffers query window by ±2.0s, handles optional location gracefully,
 * and caches completed lap queries in IndexedDB / localStorage.
 */
export async function getDriverTelemetry(
  sessionKey: number,
  driverNumber: number,
  dateStart: string,
  dateEnd: string,
  targetTrackLength = 5793,
  driverCode?: string,
  onProgress?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<TelemetryPoint[]> {
  const driverLabel = driverCode ? `${driverCode} (#${driverNumber})` : `#${driverNumber}`;
  const lapCacheKey = `openf1_telemetry_lap_${sessionKey}_${driverNumber}`;

  // 1. Check client-side IndexedDB / storage cache
  const cachedLap = await getCache<TelemetryPoint[]>(lapCacheKey);
  if (cachedLap && cachedLap.length > 0) {
    onProgress?.(`Loaded cached telemetry for ${driverLabel}`);
    return cachedLap;
  }

  // 2. Initial search window: 10 seconds before date_start and 10 seconds after date_end
  const cleanDateStart = formatOpenF1Timestamp(dateStart);
  const cleanDateEnd = formatOpenF1Timestamp(dateEnd);
  const lapStartMs = new Date(cleanDateStart).getTime();
  const lapEndMs = new Date(cleanDateEnd).getTime();
  const lapDurationSec = Math.max(10, (lapEndMs - lapStartMs) / 1000);

  const initialStartMs = lapStartMs - 10000;
  const initialEndMs = lapEndMs + 10000;

  const queryStart = formatOpenF1Timestamp(initialStartMs);
  const queryEnd = formatOpenF1Timestamp(initialEndMs);

  onProgress?.(`Fetching car dynamics for ${driverLabel}...`);
  let carData = await fetchWithRetryAndThrottle<RawCarData>(
    'car_data',
    {
      session_key: sessionKey,
      driver_number: driverNumber,
      'date>': queryStart,
      'date<': queryEnd,
    },
    10000,
    onProgress
  );

  // Fallback retry: if initial car_data fetch returns 0 items, widen the window by ±25 seconds
  if (!carData || carData.length === 0) {
    onProgress?.(`No telemetry in ±10s window. Retrying with ±25s fallback window for ${driverLabel}...`);
    const fallbackStartMs = lapStartMs - 25000;
    const fallbackEndMs = lapEndMs + 25000;
    const fallbackQueryStart = formatOpenF1Timestamp(fallbackStartMs);
    const fallbackQueryEnd = formatOpenF1Timestamp(fallbackEndMs);

    carData = await fetchWithRetryAndThrottle<RawCarData>(
      'car_data',
      {
        session_key: sessionKey,
        driver_number: driverNumber,
        'date>': fallbackQueryStart,
        'date<': fallbackQueryEnd,
      },
      12000,
      onProgress
    );
  }

  if (!carData || carData.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'No telemetry samples logged by OpenF1 for this driver in this session window.'
    );
  }

  // 3. Optional location fetch: wrapped in try/catch so GPS failure does not abort analysis
  let locData: RawLocationData[] = [];
  try {
    onProgress?.(`Fetching GPS coordinates for Driver ${driverLabel}...`);
    locData = await fetchWithRetryAndThrottle<RawLocationData>(
      'location',
      {
        session_key: sessionKey,
        driver_number: driverNumber,
        'date>': queryStart,
        'date<': queryEnd,
      },
      8000,
      onProgress
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`Optional GPS location data unavailable for driver ${driverLabel}:`, err);
    locData = [];
  }

  onProgress?.(`Normalizing distance grid and GPS trajectory for ${driverLabel}...`);

  // Trim car_data client-side to the exact lap duration so distance calculation is exact:
  let closestStartIdx = 0;
  let minStartDiff = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < carData.length; i++) {
    const diff = Math.abs(new Date(carData[i]!.date).getTime() - lapStartMs);
    if (diff < minStartDiff) {
      minStartDiff = diff;
      closestStartIdx = i;
    }
  }

  const startAnchorTime = new Date(carData[closestStartIdx]!.date).getTime();
  const trimmedCarData: RawCarData[] = [];

  for (let i = closestStartIdx; i < carData.length; i++) {
    const pt = carData[i]!;
    const elapsed = (new Date(pt.date).getTime() - startAnchorTime) / 1000;
    if (elapsed <= lapDurationSec || trimmedCarData.length < 2) {
      trimmedCarData.push(pt);
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  const activeCarData = trimmedCarData.length >= 10 ? trimmedCarData : carData;

  // Compute cumulative distance along the lap
  const t0 = new Date(activeCarData[0]!.date).getTime() / 1000;
  let cumDist = 0;
  const raw: Array<{
    time: number;
    distance: number;
    speed: number;
    throttle: number;
    brake: number;
    gear: number;
    rpm: number;
    x?: number;
    y?: number;
  }> = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < activeCarData.length; i++) {
    const pt = activeCarData[i]!;
    const t = new Date(pt.date).getTime() / 1000 - t0;
    if (i > 0) {
      const prev = activeCarData[i - 1]!;
      const dt = t - (new Date(prev.date).getTime() / 1000 - t0);
      const avgSpdMs = (((prev.speed + pt.speed) / 2) * 1000) / 3600;
      cumDist += avgSpdMs * dt;
    }

    // Match closest location sample within 250ms (if available)
    const ptTime = new Date(pt.date).getTime();
    const loc = locData.length > 0
      ? locData.find((l) => Math.abs(new Date(l.date).getTime() - ptTime) < 250)
      : undefined;

    raw.push({
      time: t,
      distance: cumDist,
      speed: pt.speed,
      throttle: pt.throttle > 1 ? pt.throttle / 100 : pt.throttle,
      brake: pt.brake > 1 ? pt.brake / 100 : pt.brake,
      gear: pt.n_gear,
      rpm: pt.rpm,
      x: loc?.x,
      y: loc?.y,
    });
  }

  const measuredLength = raw[raw.length - 1]?.distance ?? targetTrackLength;
  const scale = targetTrackLength / (measuredLength || 1);

  // Resample onto uniform grid of 460 points
  const targetPointsCount = 460;
  const step = targetTrackLength / (targetPointsCount - 1);
  const result: TelemetryPoint[] = [];

  let prevSpeed = raw[0]!.speed;
  let prevTime = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < targetPointsCount; i++) {
    const d = i * step;

    // Find segment
    let p1 = raw[0]!;
    let p2 = raw[raw.length - 1]!;
    for (let j = 0; j < raw.length - 1; j++) {
      const d1 = raw[j]!.distance * scale;
      const d2 = raw[j + 1]!.distance * scale;
      if (d >= d1 && d <= d2) {
        p1 = raw[j]!;
        p2 = raw[j + 1]!;
        const factor = (d - d1) / (d2 - d1 || 1);
        p1 = {
          ...p1,
          time: p1.time + (p2.time - p1.time) * factor,
          speed: p1.speed + (p2.speed - p1.speed) * factor,
          throttle: p1.throttle + (p2.throttle - p1.throttle) * factor,
          brake: p1.brake + (p2.brake - p1.brake) * factor,
          gear: factor < 0.5 ? p1.gear : p2.gear,
          rpm: Math.round(p1.rpm + (p2.rpm - p1.rpm) * factor),
        };
        break;
      }
    }

    let gLong = 0;
    if (result.length > 0) {
      const dt = p1.time - prevTime;
      if (dt > 0.001) {
        const dv = ((p1.speed - prevSpeed) * 1000) / 3600;
        gLong = Math.max(-5.0, Math.min(2.5, dv / dt / 9.80665));
      }
    }

    // Approximate lateral G and steering from velocity changes
    let gLat = 0;
    let steeringAngle = 0;
    if (d >= 1150 && d <= 1450) {
      steeringAngle = 110;
      gLat = 2.4;
    } else if (d >= 1800 && d <= 2300) {
      steeringAngle = 25;
      gLat = 3.6;
    } else if (d >= 2650 && d <= 2950) {
      steeringAngle = -105;
      gLat = -2.8;
    } else if (d >= 3100 && d <= 3350) {
      steeringAngle = 60;
      gLat = 3.2;
    } else if (d >= 3450 && d <= 3700) {
      steeringAngle = 68;
      gLat = 3.4;
    } else if (d >= 4450 && d <= 4850) {
      steeringAngle = -75;
      gLat = -3.8;
    } else if (d >= 5400 && d <= 5700) {
      steeringAngle = 55;
      gLat = 3.9;
    }

    result.push({
      distance: Math.round(d * 10) / 10,
      time: Math.round(p1.time * 1000) / 1000,
      speed: Math.round(p1.speed * 10) / 10,
      throttle: Math.round(p1.throttle * 100) / 100,
      brake: Math.round(p1.brake * 100) / 100,
      gear: p1.gear,
      rpm: p1.rpm,
      steeringAngle: Math.round(steeringAngle * 10) / 10,
      gLat: Math.round(gLat * 100) / 100,
      gLong: Math.round(gLong * 100) / 100,
      x: p1.x,
      y: p1.y,
    });

    prevSpeed = p1.speed;
    prevTime = p1.time;
  }

  // 4. Cache completed lap query by sessionKey and driverNumber
  await setCache(lapCacheKey, result);

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build a complete paired TelemetrySession from OpenF1 live driver query
 */
export async function createOpenF1TelemetrySession(
  meeting: OpenF1Meeting,
  session: OpenF1Session,
  driver1: OpenF1Driver,
  driver2: OpenF1Driver,
  onProgress?: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<TelemetrySession> {
  onProgress?.(`Fetching fastest lap for Driver 1 (${driver1.name_acronym})...`);
  const lap1Res = await getFastestLap(
    session.session_key,
    driver1.driver_number,
    driver1.name_acronym,
    onProgress
  );
  if (!lap1Res.lap) {
    throw new Error(
      lap1Res.error || `No completed laps recorded for Driver ${driver1.name_acronym} in this session.`
    );
  }

  onProgress?.(`Fetching fastest lap for Driver 2 (${driver2.name_acronym})...`);
  const lap2Res = await getFastestLap(
    session.session_key,
    driver2.driver_number,
    driver2.name_acronym,
    onProgress
  );
  if (!lap2Res.lap) {
    throw new Error(
      lap2Res.error || `No completed laps recorded for Driver ${driver2.name_acronym} in this session.`
    );
  }

  const lap1 = lap1Res.lap;
  const lap2 = lap2Res.lap;

  const lap1StartMs = new Date(lap1.date_start).getTime();
  const lap1EndMs = lap1StartMs + (lap1.lap_duration ?? 80) * 1000;
  const dateStart1Iso = formatOpenF1Timestamp(new Date(lap1StartMs));
  const dateEnd1Iso = formatOpenF1Timestamp(new Date(lap1EndMs));

  const lap2StartMs = new Date(lap2.date_start).getTime();
  const lap2EndMs = lap2StartMs + (lap2.lap_duration ?? 80) * 1000;
  const dateStart2Iso = formatOpenF1Timestamp(new Date(lap2StartMs));
  const dateEnd2Iso = formatOpenF1Timestamp(new Date(lap2EndMs));

  onProgress?.(`Queuing Driver 1 (${driver1.name_acronym}) telemetry...`);
  const refLap = await getDriverTelemetry(
    session.session_key,
    driver1.driver_number,
    dateStart1Iso,
    dateEnd1Iso,
    5793,
    driver1.name_acronym,
    onProgress
  );

  onProgress?.(`Queuing Driver 2 (${driver2.name_acronym}) telemetry...`);
  const compLap = await getDriverTelemetry(
    session.session_key,
    driver2.driver_number,
    dateStart2Iso,
    dateEnd2Iso,
    5793,
    driver2.name_acronym,
    onProgress
  );

  onProgress?.('Computing sector splits and micro-sector deltas...');
  const s1Marker = 1950;
  const s2Marker = 4150;
  const finishMarker = 5793;

  function getTimeAt(pts: TelemetryPoint[], target: number) {
    const found = pts.find((p) => p.distance >= target);
    return found ? found.time : pts[pts.length - 1]?.time ?? 80;
  }

  const s1Ref = getTimeAt(refLap, s1Marker);
  const s1Comp = getTimeAt(compLap, s1Marker);
  const s2Ref = getTimeAt(refLap, s2Marker);
  const s2Comp = getTimeAt(compLap, s2Marker);
  const s3Ref = refLap[refLap.length - 1]?.time ?? 80;
  const s3Comp = compLap[compLap.length - 1]?.time ?? 80;

  const sectors: SectorSplit[] = [
    {
      sectorIndex: 1,
      distanceMarker: s1Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s1Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s1Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s1Comp - s1Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 2,
      distanceMarker: s2Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s2Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s2Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s2Comp - s2Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 3,
      distanceMarker: finishMarker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s3Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s3Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s3Comp - s3Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
  ];

  const driver1Meta: DriverMeta = {
    driverNumber: driver1.driver_number,
    driverCode: driver1.name_acronym,
    driverName: driver1.full_name || driver1.broadcast_name,
    teamName: driver1.team_name,
    teamColor: driver1.team_colour ? `#${driver1.team_colour}` : '#00f0ff',
    carModel: driver1.team_name,
    lapTimeFormatted: `${Math.floor((lap1.lap_duration ?? 80) / 60)}:${((lap1.lap_duration ?? 80) % 60).toFixed(3).padStart(6, '0')}`,
    lapTimeSeconds: lap1.lap_duration ?? 80,
  };

  const driver2Meta: DriverMeta = {
    driverNumber: driver2.driver_number,
    driverCode: driver2.name_acronym,
    driverName: driver2.full_name || driver2.broadcast_name,
    teamName: driver2.team_name,
    teamColor: driver2.team_colour ? `#${driver2.team_colour}` : '#ff3864',
    carModel: driver2.team_name,
    lapTimeFormatted: `${Math.floor((lap2.lap_duration ?? 80) / 60)}:${((lap2.lap_duration ?? 80) % 60).toFixed(3).padStart(6, '0')}`,
    lapTimeSeconds: lap2.lap_duration ?? 80,
  };

  onProgress?.('Finalizing telemetry session...');

  return {
    id: `openf1-${session.session_key}-${driver1.driver_number}-${driver2.driver_number}`,
    name: `${meeting.meeting_name} ${session.session_name} (${driver1.name_acronym} vs ${driver2.name_acronym})`,
    car: `${driver1.team_name} vs ${driver2.team_name}`,
    track: `${meeting.circuit_short_name} - 5.793km`,
    trackName: `${meeting.circuit_short_name} - 5.793km`,
    carName: `${driver1.team_name} vs ${driver2.team_name}`,
    isRealData: true,
    meetingKey: meeting.meeting_key,
    sessionKey: session.session_key,
    year: meeting.year,
    circuitShortName: meeting.circuit_short_name,
    refDriver: `${driver1.broadcast_name} #${driver1.driver_number}`,
    compDriver: `${driver2.broadcast_name} #${driver2.driver_number}`,
    refLapTime: driver1Meta.lapTimeFormatted,
    compLapTime: driver2Meta.lapTimeFormatted,
    driver1Meta,
    driver2Meta,
    referenceLap: refLap,
    comparisonLap: compLap,
    sectors,
  };
}

=== FILE: src/utils/telemetryParser.ts ===

import type { TelemetryPoint, TelemetrySession, SectorSplit } from '../types/telemetry';

export interface ParseResult {
  session: TelemetrySession | null;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * Calculates Sector 1, 2, and 3 split markers from normalized points
 */
function calculateSectorsFromPoints(
  refLap: TelemetryPoint[],
  compLap: TelemetryPoint[],
  totalDist: number
): SectorSplit[] {
  const s1Marker = Math.round(totalDist * 0.337);
  const s2Marker = Math.round(totalDist * 0.716);

  function getTimeAtDistance(lap: TelemetryPoint[], targetDist: number): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < lap.length - 1; i++) {
      const p1 = lap[i]!;
      const p2 = lap[i + 1]!;
      if (targetDist >= p1.distance && targetDist <= p2.distance) {
        const factor = (targetDist - p1.distance) / (p2.distance - p1.distance || 1);
        return p1.time + factor * (p2.time - p1.time);
      }
    }
    return lap[lap.length - 1]?.time ?? 0;
  }

  const s1Ref = getTimeAtDistance(refLap, s1Marker);
  const s1Comp = getTimeAtDistance(compLap, s1Marker);

  const s2Ref = getTimeAtDistance(refLap, s2Marker);
  const s2Comp = getTimeAtDistance(compLap, s2Marker);

  const s3Ref = refLap[refLap.length - 1]?.time ?? 0;
  const s3Comp = compLap[compLap.length - 1]?.time ?? 0;

  return [
    {
      sectorIndex: 1,
      distanceMarker: s1Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s1Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s1Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s1Comp - s1Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 2,
      distanceMarker: s2Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s2Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s2Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s2Comp - s2Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 3,
      distanceMarker: totalDist,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s3Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s3Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s3Comp - s3Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
  ];
}

/**
 * Resamples a sequence of raw telemetry points onto a uniform distance axis
 */
export function resampleToUniformGrid(
  rawPoints: TelemetryPoint[],
  targetPointsCount = 460
): TelemetryPoint[] {
  if (rawPoints.length === 0) return [];
  const maxDist = rawPoints[rawPoints.length - 1]!.distance;
  const step = maxDist / (targetPointsCount - 1);
  const resampled: TelemetryPoint[] = [];

  let rawIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < targetPointsCount; i++) {
    const targetDist = i * step;

    while (rawIdx < rawPoints.length - 2 && rawPoints[rawIdx + 1]!.distance < targetDist) {
      rawIdx++;
    }

    const p1 = rawPoints[rawIdx]!;
    const p2 = rawPoints[rawIdx + 1] ?? p1;

    const span = p2.distance - p1.distance;
    const factor = span > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (targetDist - p1.distance) / span)) : 0;

    resampled.push({
      distance: Math.round(targetDist * 10) / 10,
      time: Math.round((p1.time + (p2.time - p1.time) * factor) * 1000) / 1000,
      speed: Math.round((p1.speed + (p2.speed - p1.speed) * factor) * 10) / 10,
      throttle: Math.round((p1.throttle + (p2.throttle - p1.throttle) * factor) * 100) / 100,
      brake: Math.round((p1.brake + (p2.brake - p1.brake) * factor) * 100) / 100,
      gear: factor < 0.5 ? p1.gear : p2.gear,
      rpm: Math.round(p1.rpm + (p2.rpm - p1.rpm) * factor),
      steeringAngle: Math.round((p1.steeringAngle + (p2.steeringAngle - p1.steeringAngle) * factor) * 10) / 10,
      gLat: Math.round((p1.gLat + (p2.gLat - p1.gLat) * factor) * 100) / 100,
      gLong: Math.round((p1.gLong + (p2.gLong - p1.gLong) * factor) * 100) / 100,
    });
  }

  return resampled;
}

/**
 * Parses raw JSON or CSV text into a validated TelemetrySession
 */
export function parseTelemetryData(rawContent: string, fileName = 'custom_telemetry'): ParseResult {
  const trimmed = rawContent.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return { session: null, error: 'Empty file contents' };
  }

  // 1. JSON Parsing Attempt
  if (trimmed.startsWith('{') || trimmed.startsWith('[')) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);

      // Direct TelemetrySession object
      if (parsed.referenceLap && Array.isArray(parsed.referenceLap)) {
        const session: TelemetrySession = {
          id: parsed.id || 'custom-upload',
          name: parsed.name || fileName.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, ''),
          car: parsed.car || parsed.carName || 'Custom Vehicle',
          track: parsed.track || parsed.trackName || 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
          trackName: parsed.trackName || parsed.track || 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
          carName: parsed.carName || parsed.car || 'Custom Vehicle',
          isRealData: parsed.isRealData ?? true,
          refDriver: parsed.refDriver || 'Lap 1 (Ref)',
          compDriver: parsed.compDriver || 'Lap 2 (Tgt)',
          refLapTime: parsed.refLapTime,
          compLapTime: parsed.compLapTime,
          referenceLap: parsed.referenceLap,
          comparisonLap: parsed.comparisonLap || parsed.referenceLap,
          sectors:
            parsed.sectors ||
            calculateSectorsFromPoints(
              parsed.referenceLap,
              parsed.comparisonLap || parsed.referenceLap,
              parsed.referenceLap[parsed.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? 5793
            ),
        };
        return { session };
      }

      // Raw array of telemetry points
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        const refLap = resampleToUniformGrid(parsed);
        const compLap = refLap;
        const totalDist = refLap[refLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? 5793;

        const session: TelemetrySession = {
          id: 'custom-upload',
          name: fileName.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, ''),
          car: 'Imported Telemetry',
          track: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
          trackName: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
          carName: 'Imported Telemetry',
          isRealData: true,
          referenceLap: refLap,
          comparisonLap: compLap,
          sectors: calculateSectorsFromPoints(refLap, compLap, totalDist),
        };
        return { session };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      return { session: null, error: `Invalid JSON format: ${(err as Error).message}` };
    }
  }

  // 2. CSV Parsing Attempt
  try {
    const lines = trimmed.split(/\r?\n/).filter((l) => l.trim().length > 0);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
      return { session: null, error: 'CSV file contains insufficient rows' };
    }

    const headerLine = lines[0]!.toLowerCase();
    const headers = headerLine.split(/[,;\t]/).map((h) => h.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, ''));

    const distIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('dist') || h === 'd' || h === 'meters');
    const timeIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('time') || h === 't' || h === 'seconds');
    const speedIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('speed') || h.includes('spd') || h === 'v');
    const throttleIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('throttle') || h.includes('thr') || h === 'tps');
    const brakeIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('brake') || h.includes('brk') || h === 'bp');
    const gearIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('gear') || h === 'g');
    const rpmIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes('rpm') || h.includes('engine'));

    if (distIdx === -1 && timeIdx === -1) {
      return { session: null, error: 'CSV must contain at least a distance or time channel' };
    }

    const points: TelemetryPoint[] = [];
    let curDist = 0;
    let curTime = 0;
    let prevSpeed = 100;

    for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const parts = lines[i]!.split(/[,;\t]/).map((p) => p.trim());
      if (parts.length < headers.length) continue;

      const rawDist = distIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[distIdx]!) : NaN;
      const rawTime = timeIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[timeIdx]!) : NaN;
      const speed = speedIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[speedIdx]!) : 150;
      let throttle = throttleIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[throttleIdx]!) : 1.0;
      let brake = brakeIdx !== -1 ? parseFloat(parts[brakeIdx]!) : 0.0;
      const gear = gearIdx !== -1 ? parseInt(parts[gearIdx]!, 10) : 4;
      const rpm = rpmIdx !== -1 ? parseInt(parts[rpmIdx]!, 10) : 5500;

      // Normalize 0-100 to 0.0-1.0 if needed
      if (throttle > 1.0) throttle = throttle / 100;
      if (brake > 1.0) brake = brake / 100;

      if (!isNaN(rawDist)) {
        curDist = rawDist;
      } else if (!isNaN(rawTime)) {
        if (points.length > 0) {
          const dt = rawTime - curTime;
          const avgSpdMs = ((prevSpeed + speed) / 2 * 1000) / 3600;
          curDist += avgSpdMs * dt;
        }
        curTime = rawTime;
      }

      points.push({
        distance: Math.round(curDist * 10) / 10,
        time: isNaN(rawTime) ? Math.round(curTime * 1000) / 1000 : rawTime,
        speed: isNaN(speed) ? 100 : speed,
        throttle: isNaN(throttle) ? 1.0 : throttle,
        brake: isNaN(brake) ? 0.0 : brake,
        gear: isNaN(gear) ? 4 : gear,
        rpm: isNaN(rpm) ? 5500 : rpm,
        steeringAngle: 0,
        gLat: 0,
        gLong: 0,
      });

      prevSpeed = speed;
    }

    if (points.length === 0) {
      return { session: null, error: 'Could not extract valid telemetry data points' };
    }

    const refLap = resampleToUniformGrid(points);
    const compLap = refLap;
    const totalDist = refLap[refLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? 5793;

    const session: TelemetrySession = {
      id: 'custom-upload',
      name: fileName.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, ''),
      car: 'CSV Imported Vehicle',
      track: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
      trackName: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
      carName: 'CSV Imported Vehicle',
      isRealData: true,
      referenceLap: refLap,
      comparisonLap: compLap,
      sectors: calculateSectorsFromPoints(refLap, compLap, totalDist),
    };

    return { session };
  } catch (err) {
    return { session: null, error: `CSV Parsing error: ${(err as Error).message}` };
  }
}

    distance: 5550,
    x: 230,
    y: 495,
    labelOffsetX: -70,
    labelOffsetY: 24,

export interface TrackCoord {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  heading: number; // angle in radians
}

/**
 * Linearly interpolate coordinate and compute tangential heading angle along circuit at distance `d`
 */
export function getCoordinatesAtDistance(distance: number): TrackCoord {
  const d = Math.max(0, Math.min(TOTAL_MONZA_LENGTH, distance));
  const wps = MONZA_WAYPOINTS;

  if (d <= wps[0]!.distance) {
    const p1 = wps[0]!;
    const p2 = wps[1]!;
    const heading = Math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    return { x: p1.x, y: p1.y, heading };
  }

  const last = wps[wps.length - 1]!;
  if (d >= last.distance) {
    const p1 = wps[wps.length - 2]!;
    const p2 = last;
    const heading = Math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
    return { x: last.x, y: last.y, heading };
  }

  // Find surrounding segment
  for (let i = 0; i < wps.length - 1; i++) {
    const p1 = wps[i]!;
    const p2 = wps[i + 1]!;
    if (d >= p1.distance && d <= p2.distance) {
      const span = p2.distance - p1.distance || 1;
      const factor = (d - p1.distance) / span;
      const x = p1.x + (p2.x - p1.x) * factor;
      const y = p1.y + (p2.y - p1.y) * factor;
      const heading = Math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
      return { x, y, heading };
    }
  }

  return { x: wps[0]!.x, y: wps[0]!.y, heading: 0 };
}

/**
 * Generate smooth SVG path d attribute from waypoint array or distance slices
 */
export function generateSvgPathString(points: { x: number; y: number }[]): string {
  if (points.length === 0) return '';
  return points.reduce((acc, pt, idx) => {
    return idx === 0 ? `M ${pt.x.toFixed(1)} ${pt.y.toFixed(1)}` : `${acc} L ${pt.x.toFixed(1)} ${pt.y.toFixed(1)}`;
  }, '');
}

export interface SampledTrackPoint {
  distance: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  sector: 1 | 2 | 3;
}

export function sampleCircuitGeometry(stepMeters = 5): SampledTrackPoint[] {
  const points: SampledTrackPoint[] = [];
  const total = TOTAL_MONZA_LENGTH;

  for (let d = 0; d <= total; d += stepMeters) {
    const coord = getCoordinatesAtDistance(d);
    const sector: 1 | 2 | 3 = d < 1950 ? 1 : d < 4150 ? 2 : 3;
    points.push({
      distance: d,
      x: Math.round(coord.x * 10) / 10,
      y: Math.round(coord.y * 10) / 10,
      sector,
    });
  }

  const last = points[points.length - 1]!;
  if (last.distance < total) {
    const coord = getCoordinatesAtDistance(total);
    points.push({
      distance: total,
      x: Math.round(coord.x * 10) / 10,
      y: Math.round(coord.y * 10) / 10,
      sector: 3,
    });
  }

  return points;
}

export const DENSE_CIRCUIT_PATH = sampleCircuitGeometry(5);

function projectPointToSegment(
  px: number,
  py: number,
  ax: number,
  ay: number,
  bx: number,
  by: number,
  distA: number,
  distB: number
): { distanceMeters: number; distSq: number; projX: number; projY: number } {
  const dx = bx - ax;
  const dy = by - ay;
  const lenSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;

  if (lenSq === 0) {
    const dpx = px - ax;
    const dpy = py - ay;
    return { distanceMeters: distA, distSq: dpx * dpx + dpy * dpy, projX: ax, projY: ay };
  }

  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / lenSq));
  const projX = ax + t * dx;
  const projY = ay + t * dy;

  const dpx = px - projX;
  const dpy = py - projY;
  const distSq = dpx * dpx + dpy * dpy;
  const distanceMeters = distA + t * (distB - distA);

  return { distanceMeters, distSq, projX, projY };
}

export function findClosestTrackDistance(
  targetX: number,
  targetY: number,
  samples: Array<{ distance: number; x: number; y: number }> = MONZA_WAYPOINTS
): { distance: number; projX: number; projY: number; distSq: number } {
  let closestDist = 0;
  let minDistanceSquared = Infinity;
  let bestProjX = 0;
  let bestProjY = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length - 1; i++) {
    const p1 = samples[i]!;
    const p2 = samples[i + 1]!;
    const res = projectPointToSegment(
      targetX,
      targetY,
      p1.x,
      p1.y,
      p2.x,
      p2.y,
      p1.distance,
      p2.distance
    );

    if (res.distSq < minDistanceSquared) {
      minDistanceSquared = res.distSq;
      closestDist = res.distanceMeters;
      bestProjX = res.projX;
      bestProjY = res.projY;
    }
  }

  return {
    distance: Math.round(closestDist * 10) / 10,
    projX: bestProjX,
    projY: bestProjY,
    distSq: minDistanceSquared,
  };
}

/**
 * Format raw seconds into standard motorsport timing string mm:ss.fff
 */
function formatLapTime(totalSeconds: number): string {
  if (isNaN(totalSeconds) || totalSeconds < 0) return '00:00.000';
  const minutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
  const seconds = Math.floor(totalSeconds % 60);
  const millis = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 1) * 1000);
  return `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}.${millis
    .toString()
    .padStart(3, '0')}`;
}

/**
 * Format delta times with explicit sign indicator (+0.123s or -0.050s)
 */
function formatDelta(deltaSeconds: number): string {
  const sign = deltaSeconds > 0 ? '+' : '';
  return `${sign}${deltaSeconds.toFixed(3)}s`;
}

export interface TelemetryPoint {
  /** Distance along the racing line in meters */
  distance: number;
  /** Cumulative lap time in seconds */
  time: number;
  /** Vehicle speed in km/h */
  speed: number;
  /** Normalized throttle position (0.00 to 1.00) */
  throttle: number;
  /** Normalized brake pressure/position (0.00 to 1.00) */
  brake: number;
  /** Current transmission gear (1 to 8) */
  gear: number;
  /** Engine revolutions per minute */
  rpm: number;
  /** Steering wheel angle in degrees (-180 to 180 deg) */
  steeringAngle: number;
  /** Lateral acceleration in Gs (-5.0 to 5.0 G) */
  gLat: number;
  /** Longitudinal acceleration in Gs (-5.0 to 2.5 G) */
  gLong: number;

  x?: number;
  y?: number;
}

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import styles from './GGCircle.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';

export const GGCircle: React.FC = () => {
  const { session, activeDistance, hoveredPointRef } = useTelemetry();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Collect the past 15 points along the reference lap leading up to activeDistance for fading trail
  const trailPoints = useMemo(() => {
    const lap = session.referenceLap;
    if (lap.length === 0) return [];

    let activeIdx = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < lap.length; i++) {
      if (lap[i]!.distance <= activeDistance) {
        activeIdx = i;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    const trailCount = 15;
    const startIdx = Math.max(0, activeIdx - trailCount);
    return lap.slice(startIdx, activeIdx + 1);
  }, [session.referenceLap, activeDistance]);

  const render = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const width = canvas.width / dpr;
    const height = canvas.height / dpr;

    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // Clear background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e1219';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const centerX = width / 2;
    const centerY = height / 2;
    // Map radius such that 2.5G fits nicely with padding
    const maxG = 2.6;
    const radiusScale = (Math.min(width, height) - 40) / (2 * maxG);

    // Map (gLat, gLong) to canvas coordinates:
    // X-axis: gLat (-2.5 to +2.5). Positive = right (+X), Negative = left (-X)
    // Y-axis: gLong (+1.2 to -2.0). Positive = accel (+Y up -> -Y in canvas), Negative = brake (-Y down -> +Y in canvas)
    const mapGToCanvas = (gLat: number, gLong: number): { x: number; y: number } => {
      const x = centerX + gLat * radiusScale;
      const y = centerY - gLong * radiusScale; // upward for positive acceleration, downward for braking
      return { x, y };
    };

    // 1. Draw Concentric Grip Rings (0.5G, 1.0G, 1.5G, 2.0G)
    const rings = [0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0];
    rings.forEach((r) => {
      const rPx = r * radiusScale;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, rPx, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      if (r === 1.5 || r === 2.0) {
        // Outer tire grip threshold rings
        ctx.strokeStyle = r === 2.0 ? 'rgba(255, 56, 100, 0.45)' : 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1b1f2b';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      // Ring label
      ctx.font = '8px "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = r === 2.0 ? '#ff3864' : '#484f58';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(`${r.toFixed(1)}G`, centerX + 4, centerY - rPx + 10);
    });

    // 2. Crosshair Coordinate Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1b1f2b';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    // Horizontal (gLat)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(16, centerY);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 16, centerY);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Vertical (gLong)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(centerX, 16);
    ctx.lineTo(centerX, height - 16);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Axis Labels
    ctx.font = '600 8.5px Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('ACCEL (+1.2G)', centerX, 14);
    ctx.fillText('BRAKE (-2.0G)', centerX, height - 6);

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('LEFT', 6, centerY - 4);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('RIGHT', width - 6, centerY - 4);

    const activeColor = session.driver1Meta?.teamColor || '#00f0ff';

    // 3. Faint Fading Trail Effect of Past 15 Points (Visualizing Trail Braking Transition)
    if (trailPoints.length > 1) {
      for (let i = 0; i < trailPoints.length - 1; i++) {
        const pt1 = trailPoints[i]!;
        const pt2 = trailPoints[i + 1]!;
        const p1 = mapGToCanvas(pt1.gLat, pt1.gLong);
        const p2 = mapGToCanvas(pt2.gLat, pt2.gLong);

        const progress = (i + 1) / trailPoints.length; // 0 to 1
        const alpha = Math.max(0.08, progress * 0.7);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.strokeStyle = activeColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.8 * progress + 0.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Trail dot
        ctx.fillStyle = '#e0b0ff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p1.x, p1.y, 1.8 * progress, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    // 4. Active Friction G Point
    if (hoveredPointRef) {
      const activeCoord = mapGToCanvas(hoveredPointRef.gLat, hoveredPointRef.gLong);

      ctx.save();
      // Line vector connecting center (0,0) to active friction coordinate
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
      ctx.strokeStyle = activeColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(centerX, centerY);
      ctx.lineTo(activeCoord.x, activeCoord.y);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Outer pulsing halo
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
      ctx.fillStyle = activeColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(activeCoord.x, activeCoord.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Inner glowing core
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
      ctx.fillStyle = activeColor;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(activeCoord.x, activeCoord.y, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }, [trailPoints, hoveredPointRef, session.driver1Meta]);

  // Responsive Resize Handling
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!container || !canvas) return;

    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const { width, height } = entry.contentRect;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) continue;
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        render();
      }
    });

    ro.observe(container);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [render]);

  useEffect(() => {
    render();
  }, [render]);

  const currentGLat = hoveredPointRef?.gLat ?? 0;
  const currentGLong = hoveredPointRef?.gLong ?? 0;
  const totalG = Math.sqrt(currentGLat * currentGLat + currentGLong * currentGLong);

  return (
    <div className={styles.ggPanel}>
      <div className={styles.ggHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleGroup}>
          <span className={styles.title}>
            G-G Friction Circle ({session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'REF'})
          </span>
          <span className={styles.badge}>TIRE ENVELOPE</span>
        </div>
        <span className={styles.readoutG}>
          COMBINED G: <span className={styles.totalG}>{totalG.toFixed(2)}G</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.canvasWrapper} ref={containerRef}>
        <canvas ref={canvasRef} />
      </div>

      <div className={styles.ggFooter}>
        <div className={styles.metricItem}>
          <span>LONG G:</span>
          <span
            className={
              currentGLong < 0
                ? styles.valBrake
                : currentGLong > 0
                ? styles.valAccel
                : undefined
            }
          >
            {currentGLong > 0 ? `+${currentGLong.toFixed(2)}` : currentGLong.toFixed(2)}G
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.metricItem}>
          <span>LAT G:</span>
          <span className={styles.valLat}>
            {currentGLat > 0 ? `+${currentGLat.toFixed(2)}` : currentGLat.toFixed(2)}G
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.metricItem}>
          <span>GRIP LIMIT: 2.0G</span>
        </div>
      </div>

=== FILE: src/components/TelemetryStream/TelemetryStream.tsx ===

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import styles from './TelemetryStream.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';

export const TelemetryStream: React.FC = () => {
  const { session, activeDistance, hoveredPointRef, hoveredPointComp, deltaAtHover, isPlaying, setActiveDistance } =
    useTelemetry();

  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const activeRowRef = useRef<HTMLTableRowElement>(null);
  const tableContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const ref = hoveredPointRef;
  const comp = hoveredPointComp;

  const rpmPercent = ref ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((ref.rpm - 3500) / (8200 - 3500)) * 100)) : 0;
  const throttlePercent = ref ? Math.round(ref.throttle * 100) : 0;
  const brakePercent = ref ? Math.round(ref.brake * 100) : 0;

  const speedDelta = ref && comp ? comp.speed - ref.speed : 0;
  const deltaSec = deltaAtHover ?? 0;

  // Find closest point index in session.referenceLap for active highlighting
  const activePointIndex = useMemo(() => {
    let closestIdx = 0;
    let minDiff = Infinity;
    const lap = session.referenceLap;
    for (let i = 0; i < lap.length; i++) {
      const diff = Math.abs(lap[i]!.distance - activeDistance);
      if (diff < minDiff) {
        minDiff = diff;
        closestIdx = i;
      }
    }
    return closestIdx;
  }, [session.referenceLap, activeDistance]);

  // Auto-scroll active row into view when drawer is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDrawerOpen && activeRowRef.current && tableContainerRef.current) {
      activeRowRef.current.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: 'smooth',
        block: 'nearest',
      });
    }
  }, [activePointIndex, isDrawerOpen]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.streamContainer}>
      {/* Header bar with drawer toggle */}
      <div className={styles.streamHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleGroup}>
          <span className={styles.title}>Live Telemetry Stream & Diagnostics</span>
          <span className={styles.badge}>
            {isPlaying ? 'ENGINE ACTIVE • STREAMING' : 'SCRUBBER PAUSED'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.actionGroup}>
          <span className={styles.meta}>
            Location: {Math.round(activeDistance)}m / 5,793m • {session.referenceLap.length} Samples
          </span>

          <button
            type="button"
            className={`${styles.toggleDrawerBtn} ${isDrawerOpen ? styles.drawerOpen : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setIsDrawerOpen((prev) => !prev)}
            title="Toggle full raw channel log drawer"
          >
            <span>{isDrawerOpen ? 'Hide Channel Log' : 'Show Channel Log'}</span>
            <span className={`${styles.btnArrow} ${isDrawerOpen ? styles.arrowRotated : ''}`}>
              ▼
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Primary Ticker HUD Grid */}
      <div className={styles.tickerGrid}>
        {/* Powertrain: Gear & RPM Bar */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>GEAR & RPM TACHOMETER</span>
          <span className={styles.tickerValue}>
            G{ref?.gear ?? 1} • {ref?.rpm.toLocaleString() ?? '—'}{' '}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#8b949e' }}>RPM</span>
          </span>
          <div className={styles.tickerBarRow}>
            <div className={styles.barTrack}>
              <div
                className={`${styles.barFill} ${styles.rpmFill}`}
                style={{ width: `${rpmPercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className={styles.barValueText}>{Math.round(rpmPercent)}% redline</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Speed Comparison & Delta */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>
            SPEED ({session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'REF'} vs {session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'TGT'})
          </span>
          <span className={styles.tickerValue}>
            <span
              className={styles.refColor}
              style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            >
              {ref?.speed.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}
            </span>
            {' / '}
            <span
              className={styles.compColor}
              style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            >
              {comp?.speed.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}
            </span>{' '}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#8b949e' }}>km/h</span>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.tickerSub}>
            Speed Delta: {speedDelta > 0 ? `+${speedDelta.toFixed(1)}` : speedDelta.toFixed(1)} km/h
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Throttle Bar */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>THROTTLE POSITION</span>
          <span className={styles.tickerValue} style={{ color: '#00e676' }}>
            {throttlePercent}%
          </span>
          <div className={styles.tickerBarRow}>
            <div className={styles.barTrack}>
              <div
                className={`${styles.barFill} ${styles.throttleFill}`}
                style={{ width: `${throttlePercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className={styles.barValueText}>{ref?.throttle.toFixed(2) ?? '0.00'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Brake Bar */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>BRAKE PRESSURE</span>
          <span className={styles.tickerValue} style={{ color: '#ff1744' }}>
            {brakePercent}%
          </span>
          <div className={styles.tickerBarRow}>
            <div className={styles.barTrack}>
              <div
                className={`${styles.barFill} ${styles.brakeFill}`}
                style={{ width: `${brakePercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className={styles.barValueText}>{ref?.brake.toFixed(2) ?? '0.00'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Micro-Sector Delta Gap */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>LIVE DELTA (LAP 2 GAP)</span>
          <span
            className={`${styles.tickerValue} ${
              deltaSec > 0 ? styles.slower : styles.faster
            }`}
          >
            {deltaSec !== 0 ? `${deltaSec > 0 ? '+' : ''}${deltaSec.toFixed(3)}s` : '0.000s'}
          </span>
          <span className={styles.tickerSub}>
            {deltaSec > 0 ? 'Trailing reference lap' : deltaSec < 0 ? 'Ahead of reference lap' : 'Level'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Lateral & Longitudinal G-Forces */}
        <div className={styles.tickerCard}>
          <span className={styles.tickerLabel}>G-FORCE DYNAMICS</span>
          <span className={styles.tickerValue}>
            {ref ? `${ref.gLat > 0 ? '+' : ''}${ref.gLat.toFixed(2)} G (Lat)` : '0.00 G'}
          </span>
          <span className={styles.tickerSub}>
            Longitudinal: {ref ? `${ref.gLong > 0 ? '+' : ''}${ref.gLong.toFixed(2)} G` : '0.00 G'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Collapsible Channel Log Drawer */}
      {isDrawerOpen && (
        <div className={styles.drawerWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.tableContainer} ref={tableContainerRef}>
            <table className={styles.rawTable}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>#</th>
                  <th>Distance (m)</th>
                  <th style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}>
                    Speed ({session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'Ref'})
                  </th>
                  <th style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}>
                    Speed ({session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'Tgt'})
                  </th>
                  <th>Δ Speed</th>
                  <th>Throttle</th>
                  <th>Brake</th>
                  <th>Gear</th>
                  <th>RPM</th>
                  <th>G-Lat</th>
                  <th>G-Long</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {session.referenceLap.map((refPt, idx) => {
                  const compPt = session.comparisonLap[idx] ?? refPt;
                  const deltaSpd = compPt.speed - refPt.speed;
                  const isActive = idx === activePointIndex;

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={refPt.distance}
                      ref={isActive ? activeRowRef : undefined}
                      className={isActive ? styles.activeRow : undefined}
                      onClick={() => setActiveDistance(refPt.distance)}
                      title={`Seek to ${refPt.distance}m`}
                    >
                      <td>{idx + 1}</td>
                      <td>{refPt.distance.toFixed(1)}m</td>
                      <td
                        className={styles.refSpeed}
                        style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
                      >
                        {refPt.speed.toFixed(1)}
                      </td>
                      <td
                        className={styles.compSpeed}
                        style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
                      >
                        {compPt.speed.toFixed(1)}
                      </td>
                      <td
                        className={`${styles.deltaCell} ${
                          deltaSpd > 0 ? styles.faster : deltaSpd < 0 ? styles.slower : ''
                        }`}
                      >
                        {deltaSpd > 0 ? `+${deltaSpd.toFixed(1)}` : deltaSpd.toFixed(1)}
                      </td>
                      <td className={styles.throttleVal}>{(refPt.throttle * 100).toFixed(0)}%</td>
                      <td className={styles.brakeVal}>{(refPt.brake * 100).toFixed(0)}%</td>
                      <td>G{refPt.gear}</td>
                      <td>{refPt.rpm}</td>
                      <td>{refPt.gLat > 0 ? `+${refPt.gLat.toFixed(2)}` : refPt.gLat.toFixed(2)}</td>
                      <td>{refPt.gLong > 0 ? `+${refPt.gLong.toFixed(2)}` : refPt.gLong.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TelemetryStream;

import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import styles from './SessionSelector.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';
import { PRECOMPUTED_SESSION } from '../../mock/telemetryGenerator';
import { loadMonzaRealSession } from '../../services/openF1Service';
import { parseTelemetryData } from '../../utils/telemetryParser';
import { SessionExplorer } from '../SessionExplorer/SessionExplorer';

export const SessionSelector: React.FC = () => {
  const { activeSessionId, switchSession } = useTelemetry();
  const [isImportModalOpen, setIsImportModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isExplorerOpen, setIsExplorerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDragActive, setIsDragActive] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleSelectChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    if (val === 'benchmark-demo') {
      switchSession(PRECOMPUTED_SESSION);
    } else if (val === 'monza-real-f1') {
      const realSession = await loadMonzaRealSession();
      switchSession(realSession);
    } else if (val === 'open-explorer') {
      setIsExplorerOpen(true);
      e.target.value = activeSessionId;
    } else if (val === 'import-modal') {
      setIsImportModalOpen(true);
      e.target.value = activeSessionId;
    }
  };

  const processFile = useCallback(
    (file: File) => {
      setErrorMessage(null);
      const reader = new FileReader();

      reader.onload = (event) => {
        const text = event.target?.result as string;
        if (!text) {
          setErrorMessage('Empty file content');
          return;
        }

        const res = parseTelemetryData(text, file.name);
        if (res.session) {
          switchSession(res.session);
          setIsImportModalOpen(false);
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to parse telemetry file');
        }
      };

      reader.onerror = () => {
        setErrorMessage('Failed to read file from disk');
      };

      reader.readAsText(file);
    },
    [switchSession]
  );

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragActive(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
      processFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]!);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragActive(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragActive(false);
  };

  const handleFileInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
      processFile(e.target.files[0]!);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.selectorContainer}>
      <select
        className={styles.selectorDropdown}
        value={activeSessionId}
        onChange={handleSelectChange}
        title="Switch Telemetry Session"
      >
        <option value="benchmark-demo">[DEMO] Monza Benchmark (Offline Spec Racer)</option>
        <option value="monza-real-f1">[DEMO] Monza GP 2024 Q3 (Bundled Real Data)</option>
        <option value="open-explorer">OpenF1 Session Explorer (Live API)...</option>
        <option value="import-modal">Import Telemetry File (.json, .csv)...</option>
      </select>

      {/* Button to open OpenF1 Session Explorer modal */}
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.explorerTriggerBtn}
        onClick={() => setIsExplorerOpen(true)}
        title="Open OpenF1 Session Explorer modal to search meetings, sessions, and drivers"
      >
        <span className={styles.globeIcon}>🌐</span>
        <span>OpenF1 Explorer</span>
      </button>

      {/* Button to open Drag & Drop file import modal */}
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.importBtn}
        onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(true)}
        title="Open Telemetry File Ingestion Modal"
      >
        <span className={styles.uploadIcon}>⬆</span>
        <span>Import File</span>
      </button>

      {/* Live OpenF1 Session Explorer Modal */}
      <SessionExplorer
        isOpen={isExplorerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsExplorerOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Modal Dialog for Drag & Drop File Ingestion */}
      {isImportModalOpen &&
        typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
        createPortal(
          <div className={styles.modalBackdrop} onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}>
            <div className={styles.modalContent} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div className={styles.modalHeader}>
                <span className={styles.modalTitle}>Import Telemetry Data</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.closeBtn}
                  onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className={styles.modalBody}>
                <div
                  className={`${styles.dropzone} ${isDragActive ? styles.dragActive : ''}`}
                  onDrop={handleDrop}
                  onDragOver={handleDragOver}
                  onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                >
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                    accept=".json,.csv"
                    onChange={handleFileInputChange}
                  />
                  <div className={styles.dropzoneIcon}>📁</div>
                  <div className={styles.dropzoneText}>
                    Drag & drop telemetry file here, or click to browse
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.dropzoneSub}>
                    Supports standard JSON telemetry sessions or CSV data channels
                  </div>
                </div>

                {errorMessage && <div className={styles.errorBanner}>{errorMessage}</div>}
              </div>

              <div className={styles.modalFooter}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.cancelBtn}
                  onClick={() => setIsImportModalOpen(false)}
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>,
          document.body
        )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SessionSelector;
