import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import styles from './SectorSplits.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';

interface SectorRowData {
  sectorKey: 's1' | 's2' | 's3' | 'total';
  name: string;
  markerText: string;
  splitRef: number;
  splitComp: number;
  delta: number;
  topSpeedRef: number;
  topSpeedComp: number;
  isActive: boolean;
}

function formatSplit(seconds: number): string {
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = (seconds % 60).toFixed(3);
  if (mins > 0) {
    const paddedSecs = (seconds % 60).toFixed(3).padStart(6, '0');
    return `${mins}:${paddedSecs}`;
  }
  return `${secs}s`;
}

function formatDelta(delta: number): string {
  const sign = delta > 0 ? '+' : '';
  return `${sign}${delta.toFixed(3)}s`;
}

export const SectorSplits: React.FC = () => {
  const { session, activeDistance } = useTelemetry();

  // Active sector index based on current scrubbed distance
  const currentSectorIndex = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeDistance < 1950) return 1;
    if (activeDistance < 4150) return 2;
    return 3;
  }, [activeDistance]);

  const sectorRows = useMemo<SectorRowData[]>(() => {
    const refLap = session.referenceLap;
    const compLap = session.comparisonLap;

    // Filter points by sector to compute top speeds
    const s1RefPts = refLap.filter((p) => p.distance <= 1950);
    const s1CompPts = compLap.filter((p) => p.distance <= 1950);

    const s2RefPts = refLap.filter((p) => p.distance > 1950 && p.distance <= 4150);
    const s2CompPts = compLap.filter((p) => p.distance > 1950 && p.distance <= 4150);

    const s3RefPts = refLap.filter((p) => p.distance > 4150);
    const s3CompPts = compLap.filter((p) => p.distance > 4150);

    const getMaxSpeed = (pts: typeof refLap) =>
      pts.reduce((max, p) => (p.speed > max ? p.speed : max), 0);

    const s1SplitRef = session.sectors[0]?.splitTimeLap1 ?? 0;
    const s1SplitComp = session.sectors[0]?.splitTimeLap2 ?? 0;
    const s1Delta = session.sectors[0]?.deltaSeconds ?? 0;

    const s2CumRef = session.sectors[1]?.splitTimeLap1 ?? 0;
    const s2CumComp = session.sectors[1]?.splitTimeLap2 ?? 0;
    // Individual sector duration
    const s2SplitRef = s2CumRef - s1SplitRef;
    const s2SplitComp = s2CumComp - s1SplitComp;
    const s2Delta = s2SplitComp - s2SplitRef;

    const s3CumRef = session.sectors[2]?.splitTimeLap1 ?? 0;
    const s3CumComp = session.sectors[2]?.splitTimeLap2 ?? 0;
    const s3SplitRef = s3CumRef - s2CumRef;
    const s3SplitComp = s3CumComp - s2CumComp;
    const s3Delta = s3SplitComp - s3SplitRef;

    const totalRef = s3CumRef;
    const totalComp = s3CumComp;
    const totalDelta = totalComp - totalRef;

    return [
      {
        sectorKey: 's1',
        name: 'Sector 1 (Prima Variante & Biassono)',
        markerText: '0m - 1,950m',
        splitRef: s1SplitRef,
        splitComp: s1SplitComp,
        delta: s1Delta,
        topSpeedRef: getMaxSpeed(s1RefPts),
        topSpeedComp: getMaxSpeed(s1CompPts),
        isActive: currentSectorIndex === 1,
      },
      {
        sectorKey: 's2',
        name: 'Sector 2 (Roggia, Lesmo & Serraglio)',
        markerText: '1,950m - 4,150m',
        splitRef: s2SplitRef,
        splitComp: s2SplitComp,
        delta: s2Delta,
        topSpeedRef: getMaxSpeed(s2RefPts),
        topSpeedComp: getMaxSpeed(s2CompPts),
        isActive: currentSectorIndex === 2,
      },
      {
        sectorKey: 's3',
        name: 'Sector 3 (Ascari & Parabolica / Alboreto)',
        markerText: '4,150m - 5,793m',
        splitRef: s3SplitRef,
        splitComp: s3SplitComp,
        delta: s3Delta,
        topSpeedRef: getMaxSpeed(s3RefPts),
        topSpeedComp: getMaxSpeed(s3CompPts),
        isActive: currentSectorIndex === 3,
      },
      {
        sectorKey: 'total',
        name: 'Lap Total',
        markerText: 'Full 5,793m circuit',
        splitRef: totalRef,
        splitComp: totalComp,
        delta: totalDelta,
        topSpeedRef: getMaxSpeed(refLap),
        topSpeedComp: getMaxSpeed(compLap),
        isActive: false,
      },
    ];
  }, [session, currentSectorIndex]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.sectorPanel}>
      <div className={styles.sectorHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleGroup}>
          <span className={styles.title}>Micro-Sector Delta Analysis</span>
          <span className={styles.badge}>SECTOR SPLITS</span>
        </div>
        <span className={styles.meta}>Active Sector: S{currentSectorIndex}</span>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.tableWrapper}>
        <table className={styles.sectorTable}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Sector</th>
              <th>Range</th>
              <th style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}>
                {session.driver1Meta
                  ? `${session.driver1Meta.driverCode} (${session.driver1Meta.carModel || 'Ref'})`
                  : 'Lap 1 Split'}
              </th>
              <th style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}>
                {session.driver2Meta
                  ? `${session.driver2Meta.driverCode} (${session.driver2Meta.carModel || 'Tgt'})`
                  : 'Lap 2 Split'}
              </th>
              <th>Delta (±)</th>
              <th>
                Top Speed ({session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'Ref'} / {session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'Tgt'})
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {sectorRows.map((row) => (
              <tr
                key={row.sectorKey}
                className={`${row.isActive ? styles.activeSector : ''} ${
                  row.sectorKey === 'total' ? styles.totalRow : ''
                }`}
              >
                <td>
                  <div className={styles.sectorNameCell}>
                    <span className={`${styles.sectorPill} ${styles[row.sectorKey]}`}>
                      {row.sectorKey === 'total' ? 'TOT' : row.sectorKey.toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                    <span className={styles.nameText}>{row.name}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>{row.markerText}</td>
                <td
                  className={styles.refTime}
                  style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
                >
                  {formatSplit(row.splitRef)}
                </td>
                <td
                  className={styles.tgtTime}
                  style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
                >
                  {formatSplit(row.splitComp)}
                </td>
                <td
                  className={`${styles.deltaCell} ${
                    row.delta > 0 ? styles.slower : row.delta < 0 ? styles.faster : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {formatDelta(row.delta)}
                </td>
                <td className={styles.speedCell}>
                  {row.topSpeedRef.toFixed(1)} / {row.topSpeedComp.toFixed(1)} km/h
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SectorSplits;

=== FILE: src/components/TrackMap/TrackMap.tsx ===

import React, { useMemo, useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import styles from './TrackMap.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';
import {
  MONZA_WAYPOINTS,
  CORNER_ANNOTATIONS,
  getCoordinatesAtDistance,
  generateSvgPathString,
  findClosestTrackDistance,
} from '../../utils/trackGeometry';

interface HoverSnapIndicator {
  distance: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export const TrackMap: React.FC = () => {
  const { session, activeDistance, setActiveDistance, setIsHovering, hoveredPointRef, hoveredPointComp } =
    useTelemetry();

  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const [hoverSnap, setHoverSnap] = useState<HoverSnapIndicator | null>(null);

  const refColor = session.driver1Meta?.teamColor || '#00f0ff';
  const compColor = session.driver2Meta?.teamColor || '#ff3864';
  const refCode = session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'REF';
  const compCode = session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'TGT';
  const refNum = session.driver1Meta?.driverNumber ? `#${session.driver1Meta.driverNumber} ` : '';
  const compNum = session.driver2Meta?.driverNumber ? `#${session.driver2Meta.driverNumber} ` : '';

  // 1. Check if session.referenceLap contains valid (x, y) GPS coordinates
  const hasRealGps = useMemo(() => {
    const lap = session.referenceLap;
    if (!lap || lap.length < 10) return false;
    let validCount = 0;
    for (const pt of lap) {
      if (
        typeof pt.x === 'number' &&
        typeof pt.y === 'number' &&
        !isNaN(pt.x) &&
        !isNaN(pt.y) &&
        (pt.x !== 0 || pt.y !== 0)
      ) {
        validCount++;
      }
    }
    return validCount > lap.length * 0.4;
  }, [session.referenceLap]);

  // 2. Compute dynamic GPS bounding box (8% padding), viewBox, and SVG polylines
  const gpsCircuitData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hasRealGps) return null;
    const lap = session.referenceLap;

    let minX = Infinity;
    let maxX = -Infinity;
    let minY = Infinity;
    let maxY = -Infinity;

    const rawGpsPts: Array<{ x: number; y: number; distance: number }> = [];

    for (const pt of lap) {
      if (typeof pt.x === 'number' && typeof pt.y === 'number' && !isNaN(pt.x) && !isNaN(pt.y)) {
        // Invert Y-axis so North/Up orientation matches standard circuit maps
        const normX = pt.x;
        const normY = -pt.y;
        rawGpsPts.push({ x: normX, y: normY, distance: pt.distance });
        if (normX < minX) minX = normX;
        if (normX > maxX) maxX = normX;
        if (normY < minY) minY = normY;
        if (normY > maxY) maxY = normY;
      }
    }

    if (rawGpsPts.length < 10) return null;

    const width = maxX - minX || 1;
    const height = maxY - minY || 1;

    const viewBox = `${(minX - width * 0.05).toFixed(1)} ${(minY - height * 0.05).toFixed(1)} ${(width * 1.1).toFixed(1)} ${(height * 1.1).toFixed(1)}`;
    const scaleRatio = (width * 1.1) / 630;

    const s1Marker = session.sectors?.[0]?.distanceMarker ?? 1950;
    const s2Marker = session.sectors?.[1]?.distanceMarker ?? 4150;

    const s1Pts = rawGpsPts.filter((p) => p.distance <= s1Marker);
    const s2Pts = rawGpsPts.filter((p) => p.distance >= s1Marker && p.distance <= s2Marker);
    const s3Pts = rawGpsPts.filter((p) => p.distance >= s2Marker);

    const makeSvgPath = (points: typeof rawGpsPts) => {
      if (points.length === 0) return '';
      return points.map((p, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${p.x.toFixed(1)} ${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
    };

    return {
      pts: rawGpsPts,
      fullPath: makeSvgPath(rawGpsPts),
      s1Path: makeSvgPath(s1Pts),
      s2Path: makeSvgPath(s2Pts),
      s3Path: makeSvgPath(s3Pts),
      viewBox,
      scaleRatio: Math.max(0.1, scaleRatio),
    };
  }, [hasRealGps, session.referenceLap, session.sectors]);

  // Fallback synthetic Monza path using MONZA_WAYPOINTS if real GPS coordinates are absent
  const syntheticPaths = useMemo(() => {
    const s1Pts = MONZA_WAYPOINTS.filter((p) => p.distance <= 1950);
    const s2Pts = MONZA_WAYPOINTS.filter((p) => p.distance >= 1950 && p.distance <= 4150);
    const s3Pts = MONZA_WAYPOINTS.filter((p) => p.distance >= 4150);

    return {
      s1Path: generateSvgPathString(s1Pts),
      s2Path: generateSvgPathString(s2Pts),
      s3Path: generateSvgPathString(s3Pts),
      fullPath: generateSvgPathString(MONZA_WAYPOINTS),
    };
  }, []);

  const activeFullPath = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.fullPath : syntheticPaths.fullPath;
  const activeS1Path = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.s1Path : syntheticPaths.s1Path;
  const activeS2Path = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.s2Path : syntheticPaths.s2Path;
  const activeS3Path = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.s3Path : syntheticPaths.s3Path;
  const activeViewBox = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.viewBox : '160 50 630 470';
  const scale = gpsCircuitData ? gpsCircuitData.scaleRatio : 1;

  // Position interpolation helper for beacons
  const getPositionAtDist = useCallback(
    (dist: number) => {
      if (gpsCircuitData && gpsCircuitData.pts.length > 0) {
        const pts = gpsCircuitData.pts;
        if (dist <= pts[0]!.distance) return { x: pts[0]!.x, y: pts[0]!.y, heading: 0 };
        const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
        if (dist >= last.distance) return { x: last.x, y: last.y, heading: 0 };

        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
          const p1 = pts[i]!;
          const p2 = pts[i + 1]!;
          if (dist >= p1.distance && dist <= p2.distance) {
            const span = p2.distance - p1.distance || 1;
            const t = (dist - p1.distance) / span;
            const x = p1.x + (p2.x - p1.x) * t;
            const y = p1.y + (p2.y - p1.y) * t;
            const heading = Math.atan2(p2.y - p1.y, p2.x - p1.x);
            return { x, y, heading };
          }
        }
        return { x: last.x, y: last.y, heading: 0 };
      }
      return getCoordinatesAtDistance(dist);
    },
    [gpsCircuitData]
  );

  // Compute live coordinates and headings for car beacon markers
  const refPos = useMemo(() => {
    return getPositionAtDist(activeDistance);
  }, [activeDistance, getPositionAtDist]);

  const totalTrackDist = session.referenceLap?.[session.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance ?? 5793;

  const compPos = useMemo(() => {
    if (!hoveredPointRef || !hoveredPointComp) return refPos;
    const deltaSec = hoveredPointComp.time - hoveredPointRef.time;
    const speedMs = (hoveredPointComp.speed * 1000) / 3600;
    const distanceOffsetMeters = -deltaSec * speedMs;
    const targetCompDist = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalTrackDist, activeDistance + distanceOffsetMeters));
    return getPositionAtDist(targetCompDist);
  }, [activeDistance, hoveredPointRef, hoveredPointComp, refPos, getPositionAtDist, totalTrackDist]);

  /**
   * Project mouse/touch client coordinates into exact SVG viewBox space using SVG DOM matrix inversion:
   * svg.getScreenCTM().inverse()
   */
  const getSvgCoordinates = useCallback((clientX: number, clientY: number): { x: number; y: number } | null => {
    const svg = svgRef.current;
    if (!svg) return null;

    const ctm = svg.getScreenCTM();
    if (!ctm) return null;

    const inv = ctm.inverse();
    const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
    pt.x = clientX;
    pt.y = clientY;
    const svgPt = pt.matrixTransform(inv);
    return { x: svgPt.x, y: svgPt.y };
  }, []);

  // Find closest track distance helper (handles both real GPS polyline and synthetic Monza path)
  const findClosestDistance = useCallback(
    (targetX: number, targetY: number) => {
      if (gpsCircuitData && gpsCircuitData.pts.length > 0) {
        let closestDist = 0;
        let minSq = Infinity;
        let projX = targetX;
        let projY = targetY;

        for (const p of gpsCircuitData.pts) {
          const dx = p.x - targetX;
          const dy = p.y - targetY;
          const sq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          if (sq < minSq) {
            minSq = sq;
            closestDist = p.distance;
            projX = p.x;
            projY = p.y;
          }
        }
        return { distance: closestDist, projX, projY };
      }
      return findClosestTrackDistance(targetX, targetY, MONZA_WAYPOINTS);
    },
    [gpsCircuitData]
  );

  // Click & Drag Scrubbing interaction on SVG track
  const handlePointerInteraction = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
      const coords = getSvgCoordinates(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      if (!coords) return;

      const closest = findClosestDistance(coords.x, coords.y);
      setActiveDistance(closest.distance);
      setIsHovering(true);
      setHoverSnap({
        distance: closest.distance,
        x: closest.projX,
        y: closest.projY,
      });
    },
    [getSvgCoordinates, findClosestDistance, setActiveDistance, setIsHovering]
  );

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    (e.target as Element).setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    handlePointerInteraction(e);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const coords = getSvgCoordinates(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    if (coords) {
      const closest = findClosestDistance(coords.x, coords.y);
      setHoverSnap({
        distance: closest.distance,
        x: closest.projX,
        y: closest.projY,
      });
    }

    if (isDraggingRef.current || e.buttons === 1) {
      handlePointerInteraction(e);
    }
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    (e.target as Element).releasePointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
  };

  const handlePointerLeave = () => {
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    setHoverSnap(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.trackMapPanel}>
      <div className={styles.mapHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleGroup}>
          <span className={styles.mapTitle}>Circuit Geometry & Live Position</span>
          <div className={styles.liveBeaconTag}>
            <span className={styles.beaconPulse} />
            <span>{gpsCircuitData ? 'REAL GPS TRACK' : '2D GPS SYNC'}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.sectorLegend}>
          <div className={styles.sectorIndicator}>
            <span className={`${styles.secColorBox} ${styles.sec1}`} />
            <span>S1 ({session.sectors?.[0]?.distanceMarker ?? 1950}m)</span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.sectorIndicator}>
            <span className={`${styles.secColorBox} ${styles.sec2}`} />
            <span>S2 ({session.sectors?.[1]?.distanceMarker ?? 4150}m)</span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.sectorIndicator}>
            <span className={`${styles.secColorBox} ${styles.sec3}`} />
            <span>S3 ({session.sectors?.[2]?.distanceMarker ?? Math.round(totalTrackDist)}m)</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.svgWrapper}>
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          viewBox={activeViewBox}
          preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
          onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
          onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
        >
          <defs>
            {/* Filter glow effects for car beacons */}
            <filter id="refGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
              <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation={3.5 * scale} floodColor={refColor} />
            </filter>
            <filter id="compGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
              <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation={3.5 * scale} floodColor={compColor} />
            </filter>
          </defs>

          {/* 1. Circuit Base Asphalt Outline */}
          <path
            d={activeFullPath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#161b26"
            strokeWidth={20 * scale}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          <path
            d={activeFullPath}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#1e2433"
            strokeWidth={12 * scale}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />

          {/* 2. Sector-colored racing line */}
          <path
            d={activeS1Path}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#38bdf8"
            strokeWidth={3.5 * scale}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeOpacity="0.85"
          />
          <path
            d={activeS2Path}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#a855f7"
            strokeWidth={3.5 * scale}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeOpacity="0.85"
          />
          <path
            d={activeS3Path}
            fill="none"
            stroke="#34d399"
            strokeWidth={3.5 * scale}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeOpacity="0.85"
          />

          {/* Start/Finish gantry line (Synthetic Monza layout) */}
          {!gpsCircuitData && (
            <line
              x1="248"
              y1="440"
              x2="272"
              y2="440"
              stroke="#ffffff"
              strokeWidth="2.5"
              strokeDasharray="2,2"
            />
          )}

          {/* 3. Corner Annotations (synthetic Monza) OR dynamic Sector split boundary dots (GPS tracks) */}
          {!gpsCircuitData ? (
            CORNER_ANNOTATIONS.map((corner) => (
              <g key={corner.number} transform={`translate(${corner.x}, ${corner.y})`}>
                <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="2.5" fill="#8492a6" opacity="0.6" />
                <text
                  x={corner.labelOffsetX}
                  y={corner.labelOffsetY}
                  className={styles.cornerText}
                >
                  {corner.name}
                </text>
                <text
                  x={corner.labelOffsetX}
                  y={corner.labelOffsetY - 8}
                  className={styles.cornerBadge}
                >
                  {corner.number}
                </text>
              </g>
            ))
          ) : (
            session.sectors.map((sec) => {
              const pos = getPositionAtDist(sec.distanceMarker);
              const label = sec.sectorIndex === 3 ? 'FINISH' : `S${sec.sectorIndex} SPLIT`;
              return (
                <g key={sec.sectorIndex} transform={`translate(${pos.x}, ${pos.y})`}>
                  <circle
                    cx="0"
                    cy="0"
                    r={3.5 * scale}
                    fill="#ffffff"
                    stroke="#0a0c10"
                    strokeWidth={1.2 * scale}
                  />
                  <text
                    x={6 * scale}
                    y={-4 * scale}
                    fill="#94a3b8"
                    fontSize={8 * scale}
                    fontFamily="'JetBrains Mono', monospace"
                    fontWeight="700"
                  >
                    {label}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })
          )}

          {/* 4. Visible Hover Target Crosshair Indicator on Track Line */}
          {hoverSnap && (
            <g transform={`translate(${hoverSnap.x}, ${hoverSnap.y})`}>
              <circle
                cx="0"
                cy="0"
                r={7 * scale}
                fill="none"
                stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)"
                strokeWidth={1.2 * scale}
                strokeDasharray={`${2 * scale},${2 * scale}`}
              />
              <circle
                cx="0"
                cy="0"
                r={2.5 * scale}
                fill="#ffffff"
              />
            </g>
          )}

          {/* 5. Target Lap 2 Car Marker Beacon */}
          <g transform={`translate(${compPos.x}, ${compPos.y})`}>
            <line
              x1="0"
              y1="0"
              x2={Math.cos(compPos.heading) * 12 * scale}
              y2={Math.sin(compPos.heading) * 12 * scale}
              stroke={compColor}
              strokeWidth={2 * scale}
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            <circle
              cx="0"
              cy="0"
              r={5.5 * scale}
              fill={compColor}
              stroke="#ffffff"
              strokeWidth={1.2 * scale}
              filter="url(#compGlow)"
            />
            <text
              x={Math.cos(compPos.heading + Math.PI / 2) * 14 * scale}
              y={Math.sin(compPos.heading + Math.PI / 2) * 14 * scale}
              fill={compColor}
              fontSize={9 * scale}
              fontWeight="700"
              fontFamily="'JetBrains Mono', monospace"
              textAnchor="middle"
            >
              {compCode}
            </text>
          </g>

          {/* 6. Reference Lap 1 Car Marker Beacon */}
          <g transform={`translate(${refPos.x}, ${refPos.y})`}>
            <line
              x1="0"
              y1="0"
              x2={Math.cos(refPos.heading) * 14 * scale}
              y2={Math.sin(refPos.heading) * 14 * scale}
              stroke={refColor}
              strokeWidth={2 * scale}
              strokeLinecap="round"
            />
            <circle
              cx="0"
              cy="0"
              r={6 * scale}
              fill={refColor}
              stroke="#ffffff"
              strokeWidth={1.5 * scale}
              filter="url(#refGlow)"
            />
            <text
              x={Math.cos(refPos.heading - Math.PI / 2) * 14 * scale}
              y={Math.sin(refPos.heading - Math.PI / 2) * 14 * scale}
              fill={refColor}
              fontSize={9 * scale}
              fontWeight="700"
              fontFamily="'JetBrains Mono', monospace"
              textAnchor="middle"
            >
              {refCode}
            </text>
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.mapFooter}>
        <div className={styles.footerMetric}>
          <span>{refNum}{refCode} (REF):</span>
          <span className={styles.refPoint} style={{ color: refColor }}>{Math.round(activeDistance)}m</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.footerMetric}>
          <span>
            {hoverSnap
              ? `SNAP: ${Math.round(hoverSnap.distance)}m (CLICK TO SEEK)`
              : 'CLICK CIRCUIT TO SCRUB TELEMETRY'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.footerMetric}>
          <span>{compNum}{compCode} (TGT):</span>
          <span className={styles.tgtPoint} style={{ color: compColor }}>
            {hoveredPointComp ? `${hoveredPointComp.speed.toFixed(1)} km/h` : '—'}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TrackMap;

=== FILE: src/components/TelemetryCanvas/TelemetryCanvas.tsx ===

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import styles from './TelemetryCanvas.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';
import type { TelemetryPoint } from '../../types/telemetry';

// Visual design color tokens matching _variables.scss
const COLORS = {
  bgPanel: '#0e1219',
  bgPrimary: '#0a0c10',
  borderPanel: '#1b1f2b',
  borderSubtle: '#141824',
  gridLine: '#161b26',
  refTrace: '#00f0ff',       // Cyan (Lap 1)
  compTrace: '#ff3864',      // Crimson (Lap 2)
  throttleTrace: '#00e676',  // Green
  brakeTrace: '#ff1744',     // Red
  deltaTrace: '#e0b0ff',     // Purple / Lavender
  textSecondary: '#8b949e',
  textMuted: '#484f58',
  crosshair: '#ffffff',
  crosshairGlow: 'rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4)',
};

interface ChannelLayout {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  top: number;
  height: number;
  minVal: number;
  maxVal: number;
  unit: string;
}

export const TelemetryCanvas: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    session,
    activeDistance,
    hoveredPointRef,
    hoveredPointComp,
    deltaAtHover,
    isHovering,
    setActiveDistance,
    setIsHovering,
  } = useTelemetry();

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  const lastRefDist = session.referenceLap?.[session.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance;
  const totalTrackLength = lastRefDist && lastRefDist > 1000 ? Math.round(lastRefDist) : 5793;

  // Margins within canvas
  const padding = { top: 28, bottom: 24, left: 58, right: 28 };

  // Render pipeline
  const render = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const width = canvas.width / dpr;
    const height = canvas.height / dpr;

    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // 1. Clear background
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bgPanel;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const plotWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
    const availableHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
    const channelGap = 16;
    const channelCount = 3;
    const channelHeight = Math.floor((availableHeight - channelGap * (channelCount - 1)) / channelCount);

    const refLap = session.referenceLap;
    const compLap = session.comparisonLap;

    // Calculate maximum observed delta to auto-scale delta channel beyond ±0.5s if needed
    let maxObservedDelta = 0;
    if (refLap && compLap) {
      const len = Math.min(refLap.length, compLap.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        const d = Math.abs((compLap[i]?.time ?? 0) - (refLap[i]?.time ?? 0));
        if (d > maxObservedDelta) maxObservedDelta = d;
      }
    }
    const deltaLimit = maxObservedDelta > 0.5 ? Math.ceil(maxObservedDelta * 4) / 4 : 0.5;

    const refColor = session.driver1Meta?.teamColor || COLORS.refTrace;
    const compColor = session.driver2Meta?.teamColor || COLORS.compTrace;
    const refCode = session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'LAP 1';
    const compCode = session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'LAP 2';

    const channels: ChannelLayout[] = [
      {
        id: 'speed',
        title: `SPEED (${refCode} vs ${compCode})`,
        top: padding.top,
        height: channelHeight,
        minVal: 0,
        maxVal: 360,
        unit: 'km/h',
      },
      {
        id: 'pedals',
        title: 'THROTTLE & BRAKE',
        top: padding.top + channelHeight + channelGap,
        height: channelHeight,
        minVal: 0,
        maxVal: 100,
        unit: '%',
      },
      {
        id: 'delta',
        title: `DELTA TIME (${compCode} vs ${refCode})`,
        top: padding.top + (channelHeight + channelGap) * 2,
        height: channelHeight,
        minVal: -deltaLimit,
        maxVal: deltaLimit,
        unit: 's',
      },
    ];

    // Helper functions to map coordinates
    const getX = (dist: number): number => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalTrackLength, dist));
      return padding.left + (clamped / totalTrackLength) * plotWidth;
    };

    const getY = (val: number, channel: ChannelLayout): number => {
      const span = channel.maxVal - channel.minVal;
      const norm = (val - channel.minVal) / (span || 1);
      return channel.top + channel.height - norm * channel.height;
    };

    // 2. Draw background distance grid marks (every 500m)
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.borderPanel;
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.textMuted;
    ctx.font = '10px "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace';

    for (let dist = 0; dist <= totalTrackLength; dist += 500) {
      const x = getX(dist);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, padding.top - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(x, height - padding.bottom);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Label at bottom
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(`${dist}m`, x, height - 8);
    }

    // 3. Render each channel's background, borders, and y-axis ticks
    channels.forEach((ch) => {
      // Channel bounding box
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.4)';
      ctx.fillRect(padding.left, ch.top, plotWidth, ch.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.borderSubtle;
      ctx.strokeRect(padding.left, ch.top, plotWidth, ch.height);

      // Channel title & unit badge
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.textSecondary;
      ctx.font = '600 10px Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillText(ch.title, padding.left + 8, ch.top - 6);

      // Y-axis grid lines and labels
      ctx.font = '9px "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, monospace';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.textMuted;

      const deltaStep = deltaLimit === 0.5 ? 0.2 : deltaLimit / 2;
      const yTicks =
        ch.id === 'delta'
          ? deltaLimit === 0.5
            ? [-0.4, -0.2, 0, 0.2, 0.4]
            : [-deltaLimit, -deltaStep, 0, deltaStep, deltaLimit]
          : [0, 0.5, 1.0];

      if (ch.id === 'delta') {
        // Zero baseline emphasis
        const zeroY = getY(0, ch);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(padding.left, zeroY);
        ctx.lineTo(padding.left + plotWidth, zeroY);
        ctx.stroke();

        yTicks.forEach((tickVal) => {
          const y = getY(tickVal, ch);
          ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.gridLine;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
          ctx.lineTo(padding.left + plotWidth, y);
          ctx.stroke();

          const label = `${tickVal > 0 ? '+' : ''}${tickVal % 1 === 0 ? tickVal.toFixed(0) : tickVal.toFixed(1)}s`;
          ctx.fillText(label, padding.left - 6, y + 3);
        });
      } else {
        const steps = 4;
        for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
          const tickVal = ch.minVal + (i / steps) * (ch.maxVal - ch.minVal);
          const y = getY(tickVal, ch);

          ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.gridLine;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(padding.left, y);
          ctx.lineTo(padding.left + plotWidth, y);
          ctx.stroke();

          const label = ch.id === 'speed' ? `${Math.round(tickVal)}` : `${Math.round(tickVal)}%`;
          ctx.fillText(label, padding.left - 6, y + 3);
        }
      }
    });

    // 4. Plot Channel 1: SPEED (Lap 1 vs Lap 2)
    const speedCh = channels[0]!;

    // Speed - Lap 1 (Ref)
    if (refLap.length > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = refColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      refLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.speed, speedCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Speed - Lap 2 (Comp)
    if (compLap.length > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = compColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      compLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.speed, speedCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 5. Plot Channel 2: PEDALS (Throttle & Brake with subtle gradient fill)
    const pedalsCh = channels[1]!;

    // Throttle Fill & Stroke (Lap 1 throttle as primary driver profile)
    if (refLap.length > 0) {
      // Area Fill
      const throttleBaselineY = getY(0, pedalsCh);
      const throttleGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, pedalsCh.top, 0, pedalsCh.top + pedalsCh.height);
      throttleGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.22)');
      throttleGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.01)');

      ctx.fillStyle = throttleGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(getX(refLap[0]!.distance), throttleBaselineY);
      refLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.throttle * 100, pedalsCh);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.lineTo(getX(refLap[refLap.length - 1]!.distance), throttleBaselineY);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();

      // Stroke Line
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.throttleTrace;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      refLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.throttle * 100, pedalsCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();

      // Brake Fill & Stroke
      const brakeBaselineY = getY(0, pedalsCh);
      const brakeGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, pedalsCh.top, 0, pedalsCh.top + pedalsCh.height);
      brakeGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 23, 68, 0.26)');
      brakeGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 23, 68, 0.01)');

      ctx.fillStyle = brakeGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(getX(refLap[0]!.distance), brakeBaselineY);
      refLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.brake * 100, pedalsCh);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.lineTo(getX(refLap[refLap.length - 1]!.distance), brakeBaselineY);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();

      // Brake Stroke Line
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.brakeTrace;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      refLap.forEach((pt: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const x = getX(pt.distance);
        const y = getY(pt.brake * 100, pedalsCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 6. Plot Channel 3: DELTA TIME (Lap 2 vs Lap 1)
    const deltaCh = channels[2]!;
    const zeroY = getY(0, deltaCh);

    if (refLap.length > 0 && compLap.length > 0) {
      // Area Fill for Delta (Slower vs Faster relative to zero)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      refLap.forEach((pRef: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const pComp = compLap[idx] ?? pRef;
        const delta = pComp.time - pRef.time;
        const x = getX(pRef.distance);
        const y = getY(delta, deltaCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.lineTo(getX(refLap[refLap.length - 1]!.distance), zeroY);
      ctx.lineTo(getX(refLap[0]!.distance), zeroY);
      ctx.closePath();

      const deltaGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, deltaCh.top, 0, deltaCh.top + deltaCh.height);
      deltaGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 56, 100, 0.20)');
      deltaGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(224, 176, 255, 0.05)');
      deltaGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 230, 118, 0.20)');
      ctx.fillStyle = deltaGrad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      // Delta Trace Line
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.deltaTrace;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      refLap.forEach((pRef: TelemetryPoint, idx: number) => {
        const pComp = compLap[idx] ?? pRef;
        const delta = pComp.time - pRef.time;
        const x = getX(pRef.distance);
        const y = getY(delta, deltaCh);
        if (idx === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 7. Synchronized Inspection Crosshair Line & Channel Dots
    if (isHovering || activeDistance > 0) {
      const cursorX = getX(activeDistance);

      // Vertical cursor line across all channels
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.crosshair;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cursorX, padding.top - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(cursorX, height - padding.bottom);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // Glowing vertical line halo
      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.crosshairGlow;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cursorX, padding.top - 8);
      ctx.lineTo(cursorX, height - padding.bottom);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Channel 1 Crosshair Snap Dots (Speed)
      if (hoveredPointRef) {
        const y1 = getY(hoveredPointRef.speed, speedCh);
        ctx.fillStyle = refColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cursorX, y1, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      if (hoveredPointComp) {
        const y2 = getY(hoveredPointComp.speed, speedCh);
        ctx.fillStyle = compColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cursorX, y2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Channel 2 Crosshair Snap Dots (Throttle & Brake)
      if (hoveredPointRef) {
        const yt = getY(hoveredPointRef.throttle * 100, pedalsCh);
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.throttleTrace;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cursorX, yt, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        const yb = getY(hoveredPointRef.brake * 100, pedalsCh);
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.brakeTrace;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cursorX, yb, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Channel 3 Crosshair Snap Dot (Delta)
      if (deltaAtHover !== null) {
        const yd = getY(deltaAtHover, deltaCh);
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.deltaTrace;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cursorX, yd, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Distance indicator flag at bottom of crosshair
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(14, 18, 25, 0.9)';
      ctx.strokeStyle = refColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      const tagText = `${Math.round(activeDistance)}m`;
      ctx.font = '700 9px "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, monospace';
      const tagWidth = ctx.measureText(tagText).width + 8;
      const tagX = Math.max(padding.left, Math.min(width - padding.right - tagWidth, cursorX - tagWidth / 2));
      const tagY = height - padding.bottom + 4;

      ctx.fillRect(tagX, tagY, tagWidth, 14);
      ctx.strokeRect(tagX, tagY, tagWidth, 14);
      ctx.fillStyle = refColor;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(tagText, tagX + tagWidth / 2, tagY + 10);
    }

    ctx.restore();
  }, [
    session,
    activeDistance,
    hoveredPointRef,
    hoveredPointComp,
    deltaAtHover,
    isHovering,
    padding.top,
    padding.bottom,
    padding.left,
    padding.right,
    totalTrackLength,
  ]);

  // Handle Resize with ResizeObserver & devicePixelRatio
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!container || !canvas) return;

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const { width, height } = entry.contentRect;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) continue;

        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        render();
      }
    });

    resizeObserver.observe(container);

    return () => {
      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    };
  }, [render]);

  // Redraw when telemetry state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    render();
  }, [render]);

  // Mouse / Pointer Interaction handlers
  const handlePointerMove = useCallback(
    (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;

      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const pointerX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const plotWidth = rect.width - padding.left - padding.right;

      if (pointerX < padding.left || pointerX > rect.width - padding.right) {
        return;
      }

      const ratio = (pointerX - padding.left) / plotWidth;
      const targetDist = Math.max(0, Math.min(totalTrackLength, ratio * totalTrackLength));

      setActiveDistance(targetDist);
      setIsHovering(true);
    },
    [padding.left, padding.right, totalTrackLength, setActiveDistance, setIsHovering]
  );

  const handlePointerLeave = useCallback(() => {
    setIsHovering(false);
  }, [setIsHovering]);

  const speedDelta =
    hoveredPointRef && hoveredPointComp ? hoveredPointComp.speed - hoveredPointRef.speed : 0;

  return (
    <div className={styles.canvasContainer}>
      {/* Canvas Top Bar & Channel Legend */}
      <div className={styles.canvasHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleGroup}>
          <span className={styles.title}>Synchronized Multi-Channel Telemetry Visualizer</span>
          <span className={styles.badge}>HTML5 CANVAS ENGINE</span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.legendGroup}>
          <div className={styles.legendItem}>
            <span
              className={`${styles.legendDot} ${styles.lap1}`}
              style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { backgroundColor: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            />
            <span>
              {session.driver1Meta
                ? `#${session.driver1Meta.driverNumber} ${session.driver1Meta.driverCode} (Ref)`
                : 'Lap 1 (Ref)'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.legendItem}>
            <span
              className={`${styles.legendDot} ${styles.lap2}`}
              style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { backgroundColor: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            />
            <span>
              {session.driver2Meta
                ? `#${session.driver2Meta.driverNumber} ${session.driver2Meta.driverCode} (Tgt)`
                : 'Lap 2 (Tgt)'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.legendItem}>
            <span className={`${styles.legendDot} ${styles.throttle}`} />
            <span>Throttle</span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.legendItem}>
            <span className={`${styles.legendDot} ${styles.brake}`} />
            <span>Brake</span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.legendItem}>
            <span className={`${styles.legendDot} ${styles.delta}`} />
            <span>Delta Trace</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Pure HTML5 Canvas Rendering Surface */}
      <div className={styles.canvasWrapper} ref={containerRef}>
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Synchronized Real-time Inspection HUD Readout */}
      <div className={styles.hudDock}>
        <div className={styles.hudCard}>
          <span className={styles.hudLabel}>TRACK POSITION</span>
          <span className={styles.hudValue}>{Math.round(activeDistance).toLocaleString()} m</span>
          <span className={styles.hudSubText}>of {totalTrackLength.toLocaleString()} m</span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.hudCard}>
          <span className={styles.hudLabel}>
            SPEED ({session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'REF'} vs {session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'TGT'})
          </span>
          <span className={styles.hudValue}>
            <span
              className={styles.refText}
              style={session.driver1Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver1Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            >
              {hoveredPointRef?.speed.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}
            </span>
            {' / '}
            <span
              className={styles.compText}
              style={session.driver2Meta?.teamColor ? { color: session.driver2Meta.teamColor } : undefined}
            >
              {hoveredPointComp?.speed.toFixed(1) ?? '—'}
            </span>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.hudSubText}>
            Δ {speedDelta > 0 ? `+${speedDelta.toFixed(1)}` : speedDelta.toFixed(1)} km/h
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.hudCard}>
          <span className={styles.hudLabel}>PEDALS (THR / BRK)</span>
          <span className={styles.hudValue}>
            <span className={styles.throttleText}>
              {hoveredPointRef ? `${Math.round(hoveredPointRef.throttle * 100)}%` : '—'}
            </span>
            {' / '}
            <span className={styles.brakeText}>
              {hoveredPointRef ? `${Math.round(hoveredPointRef.brake * 100)}%` : '—'}
            </span>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.hudSubText}>Pressure input</span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.hudCard}>
          <span className={styles.hudLabel}>POWERTRAIN (GEAR / RPM)</span>
          <span className={styles.hudValue}>
            G{hoveredPointRef?.gear ?? 1} • {hoveredPointRef?.rpm.toLocaleString() ?? '—'}
          </span>
          <span className={styles.hudSubText}>6-speed sequential</span>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.hudCard}>
          <span className={styles.hudLabel}>
            DELTA TIME ({session.driver2Meta?.driverCode || 'LAP 2'})
          </span>
          <span
            className={`${styles.hudValue} ${
              (deltaAtHover ?? 0) > 0 ? styles.slower : styles.faster
            }`}
          >
            {deltaAtHover !== null
              ? `${deltaAtHover > 0 ? '+' : ''}${deltaAtHover.toFixed(3)}s`
              : '0.000s'}
          </span>
          <span className={styles.hudSubText}>
            {(deltaAtHover ?? 0) > 0
              ? `Trailing ${session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'reference'}`
              : `Ahead of ${session.driver1Meta?.driverCode || 'reference'}`}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TelemetryCanvas;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import styles from './SessionExplorer.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';
import {
  getMeetings,
  getSessions,
  getDrivers,
  createOpenF1TelemetrySession,
  loadMonzaRealSession,
} from '../../services/openF1Service';
import type {
  OpenF1Meeting,
  OpenF1Session,
  OpenF1Driver,
} from '../../types/telemetry';

interface SessionExplorerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const AVAILABLE_YEARS = [2026, 2025, 2024, 2023];

export const SessionExplorer: React.FC<SessionExplorerProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { switchSession } = useTelemetry();

  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(2024);
  const [meetings, setMeetings] = useState<OpenF1Meeting[]>([]);
  const [selectedMeeting, setSelectedMeeting] = useState<OpenF1Meeting | null>(null);

  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<OpenF1Session[]>([]);
  const [selectedSession, setSelectedSession] = useState<OpenF1Session | null>(null);

  const [drivers, setDrivers] = useState<OpenF1Driver[]>([]);
  const [driver1, setDriver1] = useState<OpenF1Driver | null>(null);
  const [driver2, setDriver2] = useState<OpenF1Driver | null>(null);

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 1. Fetch meetings when Year changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadMeetings() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setStatusMessage(`Fetching ${selectedYear} Grand Prix calendar...`);
      try {
        const list = await getMeetings(selectedYear);
        if (isMounted) {
          setMeetings(list);
          const monza = list.find((m) => m.circuit_short_name.toLowerCase().includes('monza'));
          setSelectedMeeting(monza || list[0] || null);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (isMounted) setErrorMessage((err as Error).message);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setStatusMessage(null);
        }
      }
    }

    loadMeetings();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [isOpen, selectedYear]);

  // 2. Fetch sessions when selectedMeeting changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedMeeting) {
      return;
    }
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadSessions() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setStatusMessage(`Fetching sessions for ${selectedMeeting?.meeting_name}...`);
      try {
        const list = await getSessions(selectedMeeting!.meeting_key);
        if (isMounted) {
          setSessions(list);
          const qualifying = list.find(
            (s) => s.session_name.toLowerCase().includes('qualifying') || s.session_type === 'Qualifying'
          );
          setSelectedSession(qualifying || list[0] || null);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (isMounted) setErrorMessage((err as Error).message);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setStatusMessage(null);
        }
      }
    }

    loadSessions();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [selectedMeeting]);

  // 3. Fetch drivers when selectedSession changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedSession) {
      return;
    }
    let isMounted = true;

    async function loadDriversList() {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setStatusMessage(`Fetching driver entry list for ${selectedSession?.session_name}...`);
      try {
        const list = await getDrivers(selectedSession!.session_key);
        if (isMounted) {
          setDrivers(list);
          const lec = list.find((d) => d.name_acronym === 'LEC');
          const ver = list.find((d) => d.name_acronym === 'VER');
          setDriver1(lec || list[0] || null);
          setDriver2(ver || list[1] || null);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (isMounted) setErrorMessage((err as Error).message);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setStatusMessage(null);
        }
      }
    }

    loadDriversList();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [selectedSession]);

  // Handle instant Monza Demo fast load
  const handleInstantMonzaDemo = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setStatusMessage('Loading verified Monza GP 2024 Qualifying telemetry...');
    try {
      const session = await loadMonzaRealSession();
      switchSession(session);
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage((err as Error).message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setStatusMessage(null);
    }
  }, [switchSession, onClose]);

  // Handle Live Telemetry Ingestion from selected drivers
  const handleIngestLiveTelemetry = async () => {
    if (!selectedMeeting || !selectedSession || !driver1 || !driver2) {
      setErrorMessage('Please select meeting, session, and both drivers');
      return;
    }

    if (driver1.driver_number === driver2.driver_number) {
      setErrorMessage('Please choose two different drivers for telemetry comparison');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      let noticeMsg = '';
      const session = await createOpenF1TelemetrySession(
        selectedMeeting,
        selectedSession,
        driver1,
        driver2,
        (msg) => {
          noticeMsg = msg;
          setStatusMessage(msg);
        }
      );

      switchSession(session);
      if (noticeMsg.toLowerCase().includes('verified') || noticeMsg.toLowerCase().includes('fallback')) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          onClose();
        }, 1200);
      } else {
        onClose();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Live telemetry ingestion encountered error, loading verified fallback:', err);
      try {
        const fallback = await loadMonzaRealSession();
        switchSession({
          ...fallback,
          name: `[Archived Fallback] ${selectedMeeting?.meeting_name ?? 'F1'} ${selectedSession?.session_name ?? 'Qualifying'}`,
        });
        setStatusMessage('Loaded verified Grand Prix comparison.');
        setTimeout(() => {
          onClose();
        }, 1200);
      } catch {
        onClose();
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setStatusMessage(null);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen || typeof document === 'undefined') return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div className={styles.explorerBackdrop} onClick={onClose}>
      <div className={styles.explorerModal} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div className={styles.modalHeader}>
          <div className={styles.headerTitleGroup}>
            <span className={styles.modalTitle}>OpenF1 Session Explorer</span>
            <span className={styles.apiBadge}>LIVE TELEMETRY INGESTION</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" className={styles.closeBtn} onClick={onClose}>
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className={styles.modalBody}>
          {/* Quick Launch Pre-loaded Monza Dataset */}
          <div className={styles.quickLaunchBar}>
            <div className={styles.quickLaunchText}>
              <span className={styles.quickTitle}>Monza GP 2024 Q3 (Leclerc vs. Verstappen)</span>
              <span className={styles.quickSub}>
                Instant zero-latency load • Verified 100% normalized telemetry & real GPS traces
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.instantBtn}
              onClick={handleInstantMonzaDemo}
              disabled={isLoading}
            >
              Load Demo (Instant)
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Stepper / Filter Grid: Year, Meeting, Session */}
          <div className={styles.filterGrid}>
            <div className={styles.formField}>
              <label>Championship Year</label>
              <select
                value={selectedYear}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                disabled={isLoading}
              >
                {AVAILABLE_YEARS.map((y) => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>
                    {y}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className={styles.formField}>
              <label>Grand Prix Meeting</label>
              <select
                value={selectedMeeting?.meeting_key ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const m = meetings.find((item) => item.meeting_key === Number(e.target.value));
                  setSelectedMeeting(m || null);
                }}
                disabled={isLoading || meetings.length === 0}
              >
                {meetings.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m.meeting_key} value={m.meeting_key}>
                    {m.meeting_name} ({m.circuit_short_name})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className={styles.formField}>
              <label>Session</label>
              <select
                value={selectedSession?.session_key ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const s = sessions.find((item) => item.session_key === Number(e.target.value));
                  setSelectedSession(s || null);
                }}
                disabled={isLoading || sessions.length === 0}
              >
                {sessions.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.session_key} value={s.session_key}>
                    {s.session_name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Driver Selection & Team Color Preview Section */}
          <div className={styles.driverSelectionSection}>
            <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Paired Comparison Drivers</span>

            <div className={styles.driversRow}>
              {/* Driver 1 (Reference) */}
              <div className={styles.formField}>
                <label>Reference Driver (Driver 1)</label>
                <select
                  value={driver1?.driver_number ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const d = drivers.find((item) => item.driver_number === Number(e.target.value));
                    setDriver1(d || null);
                  }}
                  disabled={isLoading || drivers.length === 0}
                >
                  {drivers.map((d) => (
                    <option key={`d1-${d.driver_number}`} value={d.driver_number}>
                      #{d.driver_number} {d.name_acronym} — {d.full_name} ({d.team_name})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                {driver1 && (
                  <div className={styles.driverCardPreview}>
                    <div
                      className={styles.teamColorSwatch}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: driver1.team_colour ? `#${driver1.team_colour}` : '#00f0ff' }}
                    />
                    <div className={styles.driverInfo}>
                      <div className={styles.nameCode}>
                        <span className={styles.codeBadge}>{driver1.name_acronym}</span>
                        <span className={styles.numBadge}>#{driver1.driver_number}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className={styles.teamText}>{driver1.team_name}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Driver 2 (Comparison) */}
              <div className={styles.formField}>
                <label>Target Driver (Driver 2)</label>
                <select
                  value={driver2?.driver_number ?? ''}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const d = drivers.find((item) => item.driver_number === Number(e.target.value));
                    setDriver2(d || null);
                  }}
                  disabled={isLoading || drivers.length === 0}
                >
                  {drivers.map((d) => (
                    <option key={`d2-${d.driver_number}`} value={d.driver_number}>
                      #{d.driver_number} {d.name_acronym} — {d.full_name} ({d.team_name})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                {driver2 && (
                  <div className={styles.driverCardPreview}>
                    <div
                      className={styles.teamColorSwatch}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: driver2.team_colour ? `#${driver2.team_colour}` : '#ff3864' }}
                    />
                    <div className={styles.driverInfo}>
                      <div className={styles.nameCode}>
                        <span className={styles.codeBadge}>{driver2.name_acronym}</span>
                        <span className={styles.numBadge}>#{driver2.driver_number}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className={styles.teamText}>{driver2.team_name}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Progress / Loading Indicator */}
          {isLoading && (
            <div className={`${styles.statusBanner} ${styles.loading}`}>
              <div className={styles.spinner} />
              <span>{statusMessage || 'Communicating with OpenF1 API...'}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error Message Banner */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className={`${styles.statusBanner} ${styles.error}`}>
              <div className={styles.errorContent}>
                <span>⚠️ {errorMessage}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.errorActionBtn}
                  onClick={handleInstantMonzaDemo}
                >
                  ⚡ Load Verified Monza Benchmark
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className={styles.modalFooter}>
          <span className={styles.footerInfo}>
            Data Source: OpenF1 v1 Public Telemetry API
          </span>

          <div className={styles.actionButtons}>
            <button type="button" className={styles.cancelBtn} onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.loadBtn}
              onClick={handleIngestLiveTelemetry}
              disabled={isLoading || !driver1 || !driver2}
            >
              {isLoading ? 'Ingesting Data...' : 'Ingest & Compare Telemetry'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body
  );
};

export default SessionExplorer;

=== FILE: src/components/PlaybackControls/PlaybackControls.tsx ===

import React, { useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import styles from './PlaybackControls.module.scss';
import { useTelemetry } from '../../context/useTelemetry';

const SPEEDS = [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0];

export const PlaybackControls: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    session,
    activeDistance,
    setActiveDistance,
    isPlaying,
    togglePlay,
    playbackSpeed,
    setPlaybackSpeed,
    stepDistance,
  } = useTelemetry();

  const lastDist = session.referenceLap?.[session.referenceLap.length - 1]?.distance;
  const totalTrackDistance = lastDist && lastDist > 1000 ? Math.round(lastDist) : 5793;
  const s1Marker = session.sectors?.[0]?.distanceMarker ?? 1950;
  const s2Marker = session.sectors?.[1]?.distanceMarker ?? 4150;

  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleTimelineScrub = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement> | React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      const el = timelineRef.current;
      if (!el) return;

      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, clickX / rect.width));
      setActiveDistance(progress * totalTrackDistance);
    },
    [setActiveDistance, totalTrackDistance]
  );

  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (activeDistance / totalTrackDistance) * 100));

  return (
    <div className={styles.transportBar}>
      {/* Timeline Scrubbing Bar */}
      <div className={styles.timelineRow}>
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          className={styles.timelineTrack}
          onPointerDown={handleTimelineScrub}
          title="Click or drag to seek track position"
        >
          <div
            className={styles.timelineFill}
            style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
          />
          {/* Sector 1 & Sector 2 split line markers */}
          <div
            className={styles.sectorMarkerLines}
            style={{ left: `${(s1Marker / totalTrackDistance) * 100}%` }}
            title={`Sector 1 End (${s1Marker}m)`}
          />
          <div
            className={styles.sectorMarkerLines}
            style={{ left: `${(s2Marker / totalTrackDistance) * 100}%` }}
            title={`Sector 2 End (${s2Marker}m)`}
          />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.distanceReadout}>
          <span>{Math.round(activeDistance).toLocaleString()}m</span>
          <span className={styles.totalDist}> / {totalTrackDistance.toLocaleString()}m</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Control Action Buttons */}
      <div className={styles.controlsRow}>
        <div className={styles.playbackGroup}>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={`${styles.ctrlBtn} ${styles.primaryPlay}`}
            onClick={togglePlay}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause playback (Space)' : 'Start playback (Space)'}
          >
            <span className={styles.btnIcon}>{isPlaying ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</span>
            <span>{isPlaying ? 'PAUSE' : 'PLAY'}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.ctrlBtn}
            onClick={() => stepDistance(-50)}
            title="Step backward 50m (Arrow Left)"
          >
            <span className={styles.btnIcon}>◀◀</span>
            <span>-50m</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.ctrlBtn}
            onClick={() => stepDistance(50)}
            title="Step forward 50m (Arrow Right)"
          >
            <span>+50m</span>
            <span className={styles.btnIcon}>▶▶</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Playback Speed Rate Selectors */}
        <div className={styles.speedGroup}>
          <span className={styles.speedLabel}>Speed:</span>
          {SPEEDS.map((spd) => (
            <button
              key={spd}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.speedBtn} ${
                playbackSpeed === spd ? styles.activeSpeed : ''
              }`}
              onClick={() => setPlaybackSpeed(spd)}
            >
              {spd}x
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Hotkey Shortcuts Hint */}
        <div className={styles.hotkeyHints}>
          <span>
            <kbd>Space</kbd> Play/Pause
          </span>
          <span>
            <kbd>◄</kbd> <kbd>►</kbd> ±50m Seek
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PlaybackControls;

import type { TelemetryPoint, SectorSplit, TelemetrySession } from '../types/telemetry';

export interface CircuitSegment {
  name: string;
  startDistance: number;
  endDistance: number;
  type: 'straight' | 'corner';
  apexDistance?: number;
  minSpeedLap1?: number; // target apex speed km/h
  minSpeedLap2?: number;
  maxSpeedLap1?: number; // top speed at end of straight km/h
  maxSpeedLap2?: number;
  gearLap1?: number;
  gearLap2?: number;
  steeringMax?: number; // peak steering angle in degrees (positive = right, negative = left)
  gLatPeak?: number; // peak lateral acceleration
}

function clamp(val: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, val));
}

function calculateGearAndRPM(speedKmh: number): { gear: number; rpm: number } {
  let gear = 1;
  let rpm = 4000;

  if (speedKmh < 95) {
    gear = 1;
    rpm = 3800 + ((speedKmh - 50) / 45) * 3800;
  } else if (speedKmh < 145) {
    gear = 2;
    rpm = 4200 + ((speedKmh - 95) / 50) * 3600;
  } else if (speedKmh < 195) {
    gear = 3;
    rpm = 4500 + ((speedKmh - 145) / 50) * 3400;
  } else if (speedKmh < 245) {
    gear = 4;
    rpm = 4900 + ((speedKmh - 195) / 50) * 3200;
  } else if (speedKmh < 295) {
    gear = 5;
    rpm = 5300 + ((speedKmh - 245) / 50) * 2900;
  } else {
    gear = 6;
    rpm = 5700 + ((speedKmh - 295) / 55) * 2500;
  }

  return {
    gear: clamp(gear, 1, 6),
    rpm: Math.round(clamp(rpm, 3500, 8200)),
  };
}

function evaluateCircuitPoint(d: number, isReferenceLap: boolean): {
  speed: number;
  throttle: number;
  brake: number;
  steeringAngle: number;
  gLat: number;
} {
  const segments = MONZA_CIRCUIT_CONFIG.segments;
  let currentSegment = segments[0]!;

  for (const seg of segments) {
    if (d >= seg.startDistance && d <= seg.endDistance) {
      currentSegment = seg;
      break;
    }
  }

  const { startDistance, endDistance, type } = currentSegment;
  const segLength = endDistance - startDistance;
  const localProg = (d - startDistance) / (segLength || 1);

  let speed = 250;
  let throttle = 1.0;
  let brake = 0.0;
  let steeringAngle = 0;
  let gLat = 0;

  if (type === 'straight') {
    const maxSpeed = isReferenceLap
      ? (currentSegment.maxSpeedLap1 ?? 335)
      : (currentSegment.maxSpeedLap2 ?? 334);
    
    const entrySpeed = 215;
    const accelProfile = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, localProg));
    speed = entrySpeed + (maxSpeed - entrySpeed) * accelProfile;
    throttle = 1.0;
    brake = 0.0;
    steeringAngle = Math.sin(d * 0.03) * 0.35;
    gLat = steeringAngle * 0.03;
  } else {
    // Corner
    const apexDist = currentSegment.apexDistance ?? (startDistance + segLength * 0.5);
    const minApexSpeed = isReferenceLap
      ? (currentSegment.minSpeedLap1 ?? 120)
      : (currentSegment.minSpeedLap2 ?? 118);
    const entrySpeed = 335;
    const exitSpeed = minApexSpeed + 80;

    const isTurn1 = currentSegment.name.includes('Variante del Rettifilo');
    const isCurvaGrande = currentSegment.name.includes('Curva Grande');

    let effectiveBrakeProg = (d - startDistance) / (apexDist - startDistance || 1);

    if (!isReferenceLap && isTurn1) {
      // Lap 2 brakes earlier into Turn 1, losing ~0.18s
      effectiveBrakeProg = Math.min(1.0, Math.pow(effectiveBrakeProg, 0.92));
    }

    if (d < apexDist) {
      // Trail-braking deceleration phase: heavy initial brake bleed down into turn-in
      speed = entrySpeed - (entrySpeed - minApexSpeed) * Math.sin((effectiveBrakeProg * Math.PI) / 2);

      if (effectiveBrakeProg < 0.60) {
        brake = clamp(0.98 - effectiveBrakeProg * 0.35, 0.2, 1.0);
        throttle = 0.0;
      } else {
        // Trail-braking: bleeding off brake pressure while applying steering lock
        brake = clamp((1 - effectiveBrakeProg) * 0.65, 0.0, 0.6);
        throttle = 0.05;
      }

      const steerPeak = currentSegment.steeringMax ?? 60;
      steeringAngle = steerPeak * Math.sin((effectiveBrakeProg * Math.PI) / 2);
    } else {
      // Corner exit phase: Unwinding steering while feeding in throttle
      const exitProg = (d - apexDist) / (endDistance - apexDist || 1);
      let exitApexSpeed = minApexSpeed;

      if (!isReferenceLap && isCurvaGrande) {
        exitApexSpeed += 3.5; // sustains higher apex speed (+0.09s gained back)
      }

      speed = exitApexSpeed + (exitSpeed - exitApexSpeed) * Math.pow(exitProg, 0.82);

      brake = 0.0;
      throttle = clamp(0.35 + exitProg * 0.65, 0.0, 1.0);

      const steerPeak = currentSegment.steeringMax ?? 60;
      steeringAngle = steerPeak * (1 - Math.pow(exitProg, 1.25));
    }

    const gLatPeak = currentSegment.gLatPeak ?? 2.0;
    const normAngle = steeringAngle / (Math.abs(currentSegment.steeringMax ?? 60) || 1);
    gLat = clamp(gLatPeak * normAngle * (speed / 260), -2.5, 2.5);
  }

  return {
    speed: Math.round(speed * 10) / 10,
    throttle: Math.round(throttle * 100) / 100,
    brake: Math.round(brake * 100) / 100,
    steeringAngle: Math.round(steeringAngle * 10) / 10,
    gLat: Math.round(gLat * 100) / 100,
  };
}

export function generateLapTelemetry(isReferenceLap: boolean): TelemetryPoint[] {
  const totalLength = MONZA_CIRCUIT_CONFIG.totalLength; // 5793m
  const interval = 12.5; // ~464 points across 5,793m
  const points: TelemetryPoint[] = [];

  let currentDist = 0;
  let cumulativeTime = 0;
  let prevSpeedKmh = 280;

  // Global physics calibration scaler
  const baseScale = 0.999;

  while (currentDist <= totalLength) {
    const rawPhysics = evaluateCircuitPoint(currentDist, isReferenceLap);
    const speedKmh = rawPhysics.speed * baseScale;

    if (points.length > 0) {
      const prevPoint = points[points.length - 1]!;
      const deltaDistance = currentDist - prevPoint.distance;
      const avgSpeedKmh = Math.max(30, (prevSpeedKmh + speedKmh) / 2);
      const avgSpeedMs = (avgSpeedKmh * 1000) / 3600;
      const deltaTime = deltaDistance / avgSpeedMs;
      cumulativeTime += deltaTime;
    }

    let gLong = 0;
    if (points.length > 0) {
      const prevPoint = points[points.length - 1]!;
      const dt = cumulativeTime - prevPoint.time;
      if (dt > 0.0001) {
        const dv = ((speedKmh - prevSpeedKmh) * 1000) / 3600;
        const accelMs2 = dv / dt;
        gLong = clamp(accelMs2 / 9.80665, -2.0, 1.2);
      }
    }

    const { gear, rpm } = calculateGearAndRPM(speedKmh);

    points.push({
      distance: Math.round(currentDist * 10) / 10,
      time: Math.round(cumulativeTime * 1000) / 1000,
      speed: Math.round(speedKmh * 10) / 10,
      throttle: rawPhysics.throttle,
      brake: rawPhysics.brake,
      gear,
      rpm,
      steeringAngle: rawPhysics.steeringAngle,
      gLat: rawPhysics.gLat,
      gLong: Math.round(gLong * 100) / 100,
    });

    prevSpeedKmh = speedKmh;
    currentDist += interval;
  }

  // Exact finish line marker at 5793m
  const lastPoint = points[points.length - 1]!;
  if (lastPoint.distance < totalLength) {
    const deltaDist = totalLength - lastPoint.distance;
    const avgSpeedMs = (lastPoint.speed * 1000) / 3600;
    const dt = deltaDist / avgSpeedMs;
    const finishTime = lastPoint.time + dt;
    const { gear, rpm } = calculateGearAndRPM(lastPoint.speed);

    points.push({
      distance: totalLength,
      time: Math.round(finishTime * 1000) / 1000,
      speed: lastPoint.speed,
      throttle: 1.0,
      brake: 0.0,
      gear,
      rpm,
      steeringAngle: 0.0,
      gLat: 0.0,
      gLong: 0.15,
    });
  }

  return points;
}

export function calculateSectors(
  refLap: TelemetryPoint[],
  compLap: TelemetryPoint[]
): SectorSplit[] {
  const [s1Marker, s2Marker] = MONZA_CIRCUIT_CONFIG.sectorMarkers;
  const finishMarker = MONZA_CIRCUIT_CONFIG.totalLength;

  function getTimeAtDistance(lap: TelemetryPoint[], targetDist: number): number {
    for (let i = 0; i < lap.length - 1; i++) {
      const p1 = lap[i]!;
      const p2 = lap[i + 1]!;
      if (targetDist >= p1.distance && targetDist <= p2.distance) {
        const factor = (targetDist - p1.distance) / (p2.distance - p1.distance || 1);
        return p1.time + factor * (p2.time - p1.time);
      }
    }
    return lap[lap.length - 1]!.time;
  }

  const s1Ref = getTimeAtDistance(refLap, s1Marker);
  const s1Comp = getTimeAtDistance(compLap, s1Marker);

  const s2Ref = getTimeAtDistance(refLap, s2Marker);
  const s2Comp = getTimeAtDistance(compLap, s2Marker);

  const s3Ref = refLap[refLap.length - 1]!.time;
  const s3Comp = compLap[compLap.length - 1]!.time;

  return [
    {
      sectorIndex: 1,
      distanceMarker: s1Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s1Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s1Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s1Comp - s1Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 2,
      distanceMarker: s2Marker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s2Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s2Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s2Comp - s2Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
    {
      sectorIndex: 3,
      distanceMarker: finishMarker,
      splitTimeLap1: Math.round(s3Ref * 1000) / 1000,
      splitTimeLap2: Math.round(s3Comp * 1000) / 1000,
      deltaSeconds: Math.round((s3Comp - s3Ref) * 1000) / 1000,
    },
  ];
}

export function generateTelemetrySession(): TelemetrySession {
  const referenceLap = generateLapTelemetry(true);
  const comparisonLap = generateLapTelemetry(false);
  const sectors = calculateSectors(referenceLap, comparisonLap);

  return {
    id: 'benchmark-demo',
    name: 'Monza Benchmark (Spec Racer Mock)',
    car: 'Ray FF1600 / Spec Racer',
    track: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
    trackName: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza - 5.793km',
    carName: 'Ray FF1600 / Spec Racer',
    isRealData: false,
    refDriver: 'Driver 1 (Reference)',
    compDriver: 'Driver 2 (Comparison)',
    refLapTime: '1:26.050',
    compLapTime: '1:26.775',
    driver1Meta: {
      driverNumber: 77,
      driverCode: 'REF',
      driverName: 'Reference Driver',
      teamName: 'Apex Racing Team',
      teamColor: '#00f0ff',
      carModel: 'Ray FF1600 / Spec Racer',
      lapTimeFormatted: '1:26.050',
      lapTimeSeconds: 86.05,
    },
    driver2Meta: {
      driverNumber: 99,
      driverCode: 'TGT',
      driverName: 'Target Driver',
      teamName: 'Apex Racing Team',
      teamColor: '#ff3864',
      carModel: 'Ray FF1600 / Spec Racer',
      lapTimeFormatted: '1:26.775',
      lapTimeSeconds: 86.775,
    },
    referenceLap,
    comparisonLap,
    sectors,
  };
}
